info.title: Meteroid API v2
info.description: The public REST API v2. A request may send `Meteroid-Version: YYYY-MM-DD` to pin a version (the first, 2026-12-01, by default) and `X-Request-Id`; every response echoes the version it was served at and its `Request-Id`. These headers are documented once (`components.parameters`, `components.headers`), on no operation: an SDK sends them itself. A POST other than a preview takes an `Idempotency-Key`, and so does `PATCH /rate-cards/{id_or_code}/rates`, whose body lists changes: a retry with the same key and request replays the first response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`), or an `IdempotentReplayMarker` naming the resource's `id` when the first response was not kept (larger than 512 KB, or holding a secret). Its `x-idempotency` says whether the key is `required` (the writes that can invoice, credit or record money refuse a request without one, `400 idempotency_key_required`) or `optional`. A PATCH takes `application/json` and `application/merge-patch+json` alike: one whose body is a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it) declares `application/merge-patch+json`, the one whose body lists changes (`PATCH /rate-cards/{id_or_code}/rates`) `application/json`. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`) with a specific `code`; `403 forbidden` refuses the credentials, `403 feature_not_available` a feature the organization's plan or edition does not include. A `401` carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`. A response the request rate limit counted carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` (Unix seconds), and the IETF draft's `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit`; its `429` adds `Retry-After` (seconds). Enums in responses are open: new values (problem and field error codes, event types, statuses) may appear without a new `Meteroid-Version`, and a client must accept a value it does not know (a problem by its HTTP status, a field error as `invalid`); their values are `x-extensible-enum`. Lists are paged by cursor, `?limit=&after=`, as their `x-pagination` describes; a filter taking several values (`status`) is the parameter repeated, `?status=active&status=trial_active` (`style: form`, `explode: true`), and `created_after`, `created_before` and `updated_after` are RFC 3339 moments, exclusive. Prices and rates are decimal strings in the currency's major unit; amounts billed are integers in minor units. Requests are rate limited per tenant environment, every API key of the tenant sharing the limits: the `429` response (`components.responses.TooManyRequests`) states them.

Ingests usage events for metering and billing, 1 to 500 a request (the body 1 MB at most).
An event names its `customer` by Meteroid id or as `ext:<alias>`; its `properties` are
strings, numbers or booleans, which metering keeps as text (`1048576`, `true`). Its
`timestamp` (RFC 3339, the time it is received when left out) is between 24 hours ago and
1 hour from now, or up to 13 months ago with `allow_backfilling`.

twice. The first copy received is kept and later copies are ignored, whatever they change.

validation_failed`, each rejected event in `errors` at its pointer (`/events/3`,
`/events/3/customer`); sending the batch again once fixed is safe. With
`allow_partial_failures`, the accepted events are ingested and the `200` names the rejected
ones in `rejected`. Metering names a rejected event by its `event_id` only: an `event_id`
sent twice in one batch is matched to its copies in the batch's order.

Only the deliveries in one of these states: repeat the parameter for several
(`?status=pending&status=failed`).

200.description: A page of deliveries, newest first

post.summary: Rotate a webhook endpoint's signing secret
post.description:
The secret it replaces signs beside the new one for 24 hours, as does every secret rotated
out within those 24 hours, so a consumer rolls over without dropping events however often it
rotates (10 such secrets at most: past that, rotate again once the oldest expires). A retry
under the same `Idempotency-Key` rotates once and does not answer the secret again: read it
with `GET …/secret`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webhook endpoint id

409.description: Rotated 10 times in 24 hours, each secret still signing

get.summary: Get a webhook endpoint's signing secret
get.description:
The current secret, the one a delivery's first signature is made with. A secret rotated out
within the last 24 hours still signs beside it but is not read back.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webhook endpoint id

Activation.description:
What starts the subscription: `on_start` its start date; `on_checkout` the customer's
checkout; `manual` an operator, from the dashboard.

ActorKind.description:
Who made a change: `system` (Meteroid itself), a dashboard `user`, an `api_token`, a
`customer` in its portal, a `quote_recipient`, or an `oauth_app` acting for a connected
account.

AddOn.description:
A charge sold beside a plan: one product, priced per currency and cadence, the
subscription's cadence picking its price. A plan version offers it (`add_ons`), a
subscription holds it.

archived.description: No longer sold; the subscriptions holding it keep it.

charge.description: Its prices are each in every option (`*`).

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; paths and plan versions take it in place of the id.

description.description: What the add-on is, in the tenant's words.

entitlements.description: Its rows, canonical; each counts per instance held (seats held for one sold per seat).

id.description: The add-on's id.

max_instances.description: How many a subscription may hold; none: no limit. One charging per seat is held once.

name.description: What a buyer reads, on the portal, checkout and invoices.

self_serviceable.description: Customers may add it themselves (portal, checkout).

AddOnChanges.description: How an amendment changes the subscription's add-ons.

AddOnEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `AddOn`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

AddOnId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `add_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

AddOnList.description: A page of `AddOn` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

AddOnPurchase.description: An add-on bought with the subscription, or added by an amendment.

add_on.description: The add-on, by code or id.

quantity.description: Instances held, 1 to 2147483647; 1 when left out.

AddOnRef.description: A add-on named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

Address.description: A postal address; every part may be left out.

line2.description: The rest of the street address: a building, a suite, a floor.

AfterTrial.description:
What the subscription bills once its trial ends: its recurring fees per cadence, before
coupons, usage and tax.

recurring.description: One per cadence, the subscription's own first; empty when only usage is billed.

starts_on.description: The trial's end, when billing starts.

Aggregation.description:
How a period's events are aggregated into its usage: `count` counts them; `sum`, `mean`,
`min` and `max` read the numeric `aggregation_key` property; `latest` takes the value of the
last event; `count_distinct` counts the distinct values of `aggregation_key`.

AmendSubscription.description: Changes to a subscription's charges and add-ons, its plan kept.

add_ons.description: Add-ons added, held at another quantity or removed.

AmendmentSummary.description: The names of what a scheduled amendment adds and removes.

added_add_ons.description: The names of the add-ons it adds.

added_charges.description: The names of the charges it adds.

removed_add_ons.description: The names of the add-ons it removes.

removed_charges.description: The names of the charges it removes.

ApiTokenId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `tkn_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

applied.description: False for a report older than the last `set`: recorded, and changing nothing.

replayed.description: The store had the key: its first answer, nothing applied again.

resource.description: The resource counted; absent for the customer as a whole.

AppCountExplain.description: A limit counted by your app: the count, the last `set` and the adds since.

resource.description: The resource counted; absent for the customer as a whole.

AppliedCoupon.description: A coupon redeemed on the subscription.

applied_count.description: Invoices it discounted; absent before the first.

AppliedCouponId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `sub_cou_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

AppliesTo.description: What the credit pays: `all`, any charge (the default), or `usage` charges only.

AttributedTo.description:
Whose subscriptions bill the metric's events. `customer`: the customer's own. `resource_type`:
the subscriptions of the resource whose key the event carries (`property`, else the type's
keys, canonical first); an event naming no subscribed resource goes to the customer's own.

AttributionPreview.description:
Where the last 7 days of the metric's usage would go, summed over up to 20 customers with
subscriptions for a resource (`sampled` when there are more): what each side's subscriptions
bill, each reading the metric's aggregation over its own events.

additive.description:
The three quantities add up to the usage (a sum or count metric) and split it in shares.
False for latest, max, min, mean and distinct count: each is what its subscriptions bill,
and they don't add up to the usage.

customer_subscriptions.description: Billed by the customer's own subscriptions.

draft_invoices.description: The draft invoices the change recomputes.

resource_subscriptions.description: Billed by subscriptions for a resource.

AutoTopUp.description:
Automatic top-up of the credit that pays any charge: it charges the customer's payment method
when the balance falls to `threshold`. Threshold, amount and target are credit in minor units
of the wallet; for a credit unit wallet, the minimum, maximum and caps are money in minor
units of the customer's currency.

amount.description: With `fixed`: the credit each top-up buys.

customer_consent_attested_at.description:
When an operator attested the customer agreed to these terms; absent when the customer
confirmed them in the portal.

daily_cap.description: Most charged in a rolling day, tax included.

last_succeeded_at.description: When the last top-up was paid.

monthly_cap.description: Most charged in a calendar month (UTC), tax included.

payment_method.description: The payment method charged; the customer's default when absent.

suspended_at.description: When it was suspended; absent unless `status` is `suspended`.

target.description: With `to_target`: the balance each top-up buys back up to.

threshold.description: The balance a top-up is bought at, once it falls to it.

AutoTopUpInput.description:
The terms of an automatic top-up, replaced whole. `fixed` takes `amount`, `to_target` a
`target` above `threshold`.

amount.description: With `fixed`: the credit each top-up buys, in minor units of the wallet.

at_current_price.description:
Credit unit wallets: authorize today's price per credit, lifting a stop a price increase
caused.

customer_consent_attested.description:
Attests the customer agreed to automatic charges on these terms. Required to turn
automatic top-up on, or to change what it charges, without the customer confirming in the
portal.

daily_cap.description: Most charged in a rolling day, tax included.

monthly_cap.description: Most charged in a calendar month (UTC), tax included.

payment_method.description: A payment method id; the customer's default at each top-up when left out.

target.description: With `to_target`: the balance each top-up buys back up to, above `threshold`.

threshold.description: The balance a top-up is bought at, in minor units of the wallet.

AutoTopUpMethod.description:
`fixed` buys `amount` each time the balance falls to the threshold; `to_target` buys back up
to `target`.

AutoTopUpStatus.description:
Whether automatic top-up charges: `active` charges at the threshold; `disabled` is turned
off, its terms kept; `suspended` stopped after failed or reversed payments, a price increase
or a change of the customer's currency, or until the customer confirms terms an operator
changed.

BillableMetricId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `bm_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

BilledFirst.description: A pending invoice billed before this one that draws on the same customer-wide credit.

Billing.description:
When in its period a charge bills: `advance`, at the start of the period it pays for;
`arrears`, at the end, for what it used.

BillingCycleReset.description: At each renewal of the subscription.

Cadence.description:
How often a price bills: `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semiannual` (every 6 months) or `annual`.
Usage and one-time prices read their usage or fee whatever it is.

CalendarReset.description: On calendar boundaries (the 1st of each month…), every `interval` calendar `unit`s.

reason.description: Why it is cancelled, kept with the cancellation; blank reads as none.

when.description:
Required: `immediate`, `period_end` or `date` (today or later, not after the
subscription's own end).

Cancellation.description: A cancellation waiting for its date: revoke it with `POST …/cancel/revoke`.

initiated_by_customer.description: Asked by the customer, from the portal, rather than by the tenant.

CardExtra.description: An item of a card, in the order it reads.

amount.description:
A decimal string in the page's currency: the base price; per seat or unit; once; a
pack's. None for usage at a rate card's or by-dimension rates, and levels whose overage
varies.

from_lowest.description: `amount` is the lowest rate of its tiers: "from".

included.description: Units free before `amount` applies ("3 seats included").

lead.description: The card's price: the others read beside it.

name.description: The charge's name; empty for the base price.

period.description: How often a recurring item bills.

CardLevel.description: A usage level a visitor may pick on a card.

amount.description: The card's amount with this level, a decimal string in the page's currency.

included.description: The usage included each period, in the metric's unit.

monthly_equivalent.description: `amount` per month, for a card billed on a longer period.

overage_rate.description: Per unit used above `included`; none when priced in a credit unit or left off the card.

CardLevels.description: The usage levels a visitor picks between.

levels.description: By the usage they include, smallest first.

metric_name.description: What the charge counts, as its metric names it.

more.description:
A last stop past the largest level, sold by contacting sales; none when the ladder sells
nothing so.

CardPrice.description: What a card reads as its price.

amount.description: A decimal string in the page's currency: the card's lead price.

extras.description: The card's items in the order they read, one of them its `lead`.

from_lowest.description: The amount is the lowest of several levels: "from".

levels.description: The usage levels a visitor picks between, the card's amount reading the lowest.

monthly_equivalent.description: `amount` per month, for a price billed on a longer period.

partial.description: A charge could not be shown: never read as free.

period.description: None for a plan billing only usage or one-time charges.

saving_percent.description:
Whole percent saved paying `amount` each `period` rather than the monthly price each
month, rounded down; none unless something is saved.

id.description: The user's, API key's or customer's id.

ChangeLevel.description: A move of a usage-levels charge to another of its levels.

included.description: The usage the level includes, one of the charge's levels.

when.description:
A higher level applies `immediate`, a lower one at `period_end`; checked when sent, and
as the direction says when left out.

ChangePlan.description: A move to another plan, option or version.

levels.description: Levels on the new plan, by product code; the level held when the new plan sells it.

option.description: The option's alias; the one of the same alias when the plan has it, else the first sold.

plan.description: The plan moved to, by code or id.

prices.description:
Prices on the new plan, by product code: a charge priced by one amount (a rate, a seat,
a capacity) at its own price, a decimal in the subscription's currency, over the list
price.

quantities.description: Seat counts on the new plan, by managed quantity code; the counts held when left out.

version.description: A published version's number; the active one when left out.

when.description: Required: `immediate` or `period_end`; a downgrade at the period's end only.

ChangePreview.description: What a change would do, nothing written.

documents.description:
The documents it would issue: the invoice and credit note when it applies, the renewal
under it.

effective_date.description: The day it would take effect.

incomplete.description:
True when a part of the preview could not be priced and is left out (`missing` names
it): `documents` then never reads as the change billing nothing.

subscription_after.description:
The subscription as it would read once the change is in force: its plan and option,
charges, add-ons, quantities, levels, minimum and MRR.

timeline.description:
What the change does to the subscription's timeline (its phases, dated add-ons and
discounts, renewal), when one follows it: each written again over the change.

when.description: When it takes effect, as asked or as its rules decide.

ChangeQuantity.description: A new count of a managed quantity: `set` or `delta`, not both.

activation.description:
When an increase is in force: `immediate` (the default) or `on_payment` of its invoice. A
decrease follows the quantity's policy either way.

awaiting_payment.description: The invoice whose payment applies a `pending_payment` change.

effective_date.description: The day it took or takes effect.

scheduled_change.description: The scheduled change, revocable until its date.

subscription.description:
The subscription once changed; left out when it cannot be read back in v2 (data API v2
does not express, read with API v1): the change is made all the same.

ChangeStatus.description:
Where a change made stands: `applied` in force; `scheduled` waiting for `effective_date` (see
the subscription's `schedule`); `pending_payment` waiting for the payment of
`awaiting_payment`, the invoice billing it, and applied once that invoice is paid.

Charge.description:
A product billed by a quantity, on a timing, at its prices. Responses always carry the
canonical composition (`quantity`, `timing`, `prices`) with `preset` as a hint; a request
may send a `preset` instead of `quantity` and `timing`. A charge without a quantity, a preset
or a price includes its product for free.

included.description: Usage free each period before a per-unit price applies (metered quantities only).

name.description: Unique within the version; the product's name when left out.

preset.description:
The common composition the charge reads as; on a request, it fills `quantity` and
`timing`.

prices.description:
One per option, currency and cadence, 100 at most; ordered by option position, currency,
cadence. Empty: the product is included for free.

product.description: The product, by code or id; responses name it by code.

quantity.description: How many units it bills; none on a charge that includes its product for free.

timing.description: When it bills; left out of a request, as the quantity implies.

ChargeChanges.description: How an amendment changes the subscription's charges.

add.description: Charges beside the plan's, each with one price in the subscription's currency.

edit.description: Charges of the subscription at another price.

ChargeOrigin.description:
Where a charge of the subscription comes from: `plan` a charge of its plan, its price the
plan's or overridden for this subscription; `add_on` one of its add-ons; `amendment` added to
this subscription beside its plan, at its creation or by an amendment.

ChargeOverride.description: Another price for one charge of the subscription: the charge keeps how it bills its product.

cadence.description: The charge's cadence when left out.

charge.description: The charge, by its product's code (or id).

name.description: Its name on invoices; unchanged when left out.

price.description: Its price for this subscription, in the subscription's currency and major units.

ChargePrice.description: A price of a charge in an option, a currency and a cadence.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit the price's amounts are in; none: money.

currency.description:
ISO 4217, read upper-case. One price per option, currency and cadence; one cadence per
option and currency.

model.description: How the price turns the charge's quantity into an amount.

option.description: The option's alias, or `*` for every option of the version. An add-on's are `*`.

CheckEntitlement.description: What a check asks. `explain` and `current_count` take a secret key.

attributes.description:
Attributes of the resource, `{"site.environment": "staging"}`, for rows with a
`condition`; a stored resource's own values win.

current_count.description: A limit counted by your app: the count to check, instead of the last one reported.

explain.description: Adds how each level's value was made (`explain` on each level).

feature.description: The feature, by code or id.

requested.description: The units about to be used; 1 by default.

resource.description:
The resource the use is for, stored or not: `{"id": "res_…"}`, or
`{"type": "site", "key": "s1"}`. Left out: the customer as a whole.

CheckLevel.description: A level, as checked: the customer as a whole, or the resource the check names.

deciding_subscription.description: The subscription whose value applies here, when several include the feature.

in_overage.description: Past the limit of a level that allows usage past it and bills it.

primary.description:
The level the feature applies per (`applies_per`, else the customer): its value is the
feature's. The other levels can only cap it.

resource.description: With `level: resource_type`: the resource this level is for.

CheckReason.description:
Why the check, or a level, refuses. When several apply, the first in this list is given.
New reasons may be added: treat an unknown one as a refusal.

CheckReasonType.description: What kind of refusal it is, to decide what to do about it.

CheckoutInvoicing.description: The invoicing terms of the subscription the checkout creates.

auto_finalize.description: Invoices are finalized and sent without a review.

charge_automatically.description: Invoices are charged to the customer's payment method.

purchase_order.description: The customer's purchase order number, printed on every invoice.

CheckoutKind.description:
What the checkout buys: `self_serve` a new subscription, created when it is paid
(`POST /checkout-sessions`); `subscription_activation` the activation of a subscription
waiting for its checkout; `plan_change` a plan change of a subscription, from the customer
portal; `add_on_purchase` an add-on bought for a subscription, from the customer portal.

CheckoutPaymentKeptAsCreditEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `CheckoutPaymentKeptAsCreditEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

CheckoutPaymentKeptAsCreditEventData.description:
A self-serve checkout was paid but its subscription could not be created (its resource was
sold meanwhile, or is no longer the customer's): the payment is kept as the customer's credit
and the session is cancelled.

amount.description: Credited to the customer, in minor units of `currency`.

checkout_session.description: The checkout session, cancelled, as `GET /checkout-sessions/{id}` reads it.

oneOf.description: The plan the session sold, with its version.
The resource the subscription was for; absent for the whole customer.

CheckoutSession.description:
A hosted checkout: the customer pays on `url`, which creates (or changes) the subscription.
The quantities, levels and charges asked are the page's and the subscription's, not read back
here; a list item carries no `url` (read it on the session).

after_trial.description:
What the subscription bills each period once its trial ends; read on a single session
with a trial.

billing_day_anchor.description: The day of the month periods start on; the start date's when absent.

cancel_url.description: Where the customer may leave to without paying.

coupons.description: A coupon deleted since the session was created is left out.

end_date.description: The day the subscription stops renewing; it renews until cancelled when absent.

id.description: The session's id.

invoicing.description: The invoicing terms of the subscription it creates.

metadata.description: The integrator's own key-value data, as sent.

metrics_not_attributed.description:
With `metric_not_attributed`: the codes of the metrics it prices that are not attributed
to its resource's type, so its subscription would bill none of their usage.

offer.description: What the subscription it creates is given beside its plan, as asked: `plan` when left out.

plan.description: The plan bought, with its version and option.

resource.description: The resource the subscription is for; none: the whole customer.

start_date.description: When billing starts; the day it is paid when absent.

subscription.description: The subscription created (or changed) by the checkout.

success_url.description: Where the customer is sent once paid, `checkout_session_id` appended.

trial.description:
The trial the subscription it creates asks for, as sent; absent when none was sent (the
plan's, unless the customer already had it).

url.description: The hosted page, while the customer can pay.

warnings.description:
On creation, what its subscription would be accepted with: `plan_sold_for_mismatch` (the
plan is sold for another target), `metric_not_attributed` (its resource would never bill
some metrics it prices).

CheckoutSessionId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `che_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CheckoutSessionList.description: A page of `CheckoutSession` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

ConnectedAccountId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cacc_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

Contribution.description: A row's part in a level's value.

policy_override.description: The row gives its limit a policy of its own.

quantity.description: An add-on's instances bought; 1 for other rows.

running.description: The value once this row applied; absent when it changed nothing (`discarded`).

units.description:
A limit per unit of a managed quantity: the units the deciding subscription holds, which
multiply `value` (`running` is the product).

CostBucket.description: A bucket of usage and what it costs, priced as its invoice line prices it.

cost.description:
Rounded to the minor unit, so a period's buckets add up to what it invoices. Absent when
the aggregation cannot be priced per bucket.

exact.description:
False when the price depends on the whole period's usage (tiers, volume, packages,
levels): the cost is then what the bucket adds to the period's price so far.

group.description: The value of `group_by`; absent when not grouped, or for usage without the property.

quantity.description: The bucket's usage, aggregated as the metric aggregates.

start.description: When the bucket starts; it lasts the read's `granularity`.

CostInput.description: What a credit grant costs the customer, net of tax.

amount.description: In minor units of `currency`; zero or more.

currency.description: The currency it was paid in (ISO 4217).

CountryCode.description: A country, as its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

Coupon.description: A discount or promotional credit redeemed by code on a subscription.

applies_to.description: The plans and add-ons it may be redeemed with.

archived.description: Archived: no longer redeemable, its code free for a new coupon.

code.description:
What customers redeem: exactly, else ignoring the case of ASCII letters when one live
coupon matches so. A promotional credit code is stored upper-case.

disabled.description: Not redeemable until enabled again; its redemptions keep discounting.

duration.description: How long it discounts a subscription it is redeemed on.

expires_at.description: Not redeemable from then on; its redemptions keep discounting. None: it never expires.

redemption_count.description: How many times it was redeemed.

redemption_limit.description: How many subscriptions may redeem it; none: no limit.

reusable.description: One customer may redeem it more than once.

valid_from.description: Not redeemable before; none: from its creation.

CouponAppliesTo.description:
What a coupon may be redeemed with. Neither plans nor add-ons: anything. Scoped to add-ons
only, it discounts their lines alone.

add_ons.description: By code (id or code on input).

plans.description: By code (id or code on input).

CouponAppliesToPatch.description: A merge patch of the scope: a list sent replaces it.

add_ons.description: The add-ons, by id or code; replaces the list.

plans.description: The plans, by id or code; replaces the list.

CouponCreditScope.description: Which subscriptions a promotional credit pays.

CouponDiscount.description:
What a coupon takes off: a `percentage` or a `fixed` amount off each invoice it discounts, or
promotional `credit` added to the customer's balance.

CouponDuration.description:
How long a coupon discounts a subscription it is redeemed on; a redemption keeps the
duration it was made with.

CouponEligibility.description: Who may redeem it: every condition set must hold.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the customer's billing address; empty: any country.

properties.description: Custom property values the customer holds, each condition holding; empty: any.

CouponEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `Coupon`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

CouponId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cou_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CouponList.description: A page of `Coupon` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

CouponPropertyMatch.description: The customer's custom property `key` holds one of `values`.

key.description: The key of a customer custom property.

values.description: The values it may hold, one at least.

CouponRef.description: A coupon named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

CouponStatus.description:
A coupon's state as a list filters it: `active`, redeemable (not disabled, expired, used up
or archived); `inactive`, disabled, expired or used up but not archived; `archived`.

CreateAddOn.description: An add-on to create: a priced charge, with what it grants.

charge.description:
A priced charge (a quantity or a preset, and a price at least): one price per currency
and cadence, each `*`. How it bills never changes once created.

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; the name's slug when left out.

entitlements.description: Its rows; `add` by default when it is bought several times or per seat, else `raise_to`.

max_instances.description:
How many a subscription may hold, 1 or more; none: no limit. One charging per seat is
held once.

self_serviceable.description: Customers may add it themselves (portal, checkout); `false` when left out.

CreateCharges.description: How a new subscription's charges differ from its plan's.

add.description:
Charges beside the plan's, each with one price in the subscription's currency, 100 at
most.

override.description: Plan charges at another price, 100 at most.

remove.description: Plan charges left out, by product code.

CreateCheckoutSession.description: A hosted checkout of a plan to create, its purchase named as `POST /subscriptions` names it.

add_ons.description: Add-ons bought with it, 100 at most.

billing_day_anchor.description: The day of the month periods start on, 1 to 31; the start date's when left out.

cancel_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL offered to the customer to leave without paying.

charges.description: How its charges differ from its plan's: prices overridden, charges added or left out.

coupons.description: Coupon codes, 20 at most, redeemed when it is paid.

currency.description:
Checked when sent: a checkout is sold in its customer's currency when the plan sells it,
else in the plan's.

customer.description: The customer's id, or its alias as `ext:<alias>`.

end_date.description: The day the subscription stops renewing; it renews until cancelled when left out.

expires_in_hours.description: Hours before it expires, 1 to 8760: 1 by default, 0 for never.

invoicing.description: How the subscription it creates is invoiced.

levels.description: The level of each usage-levels charge, by product code, as the usage it includes.

metadata.description: The integrator's own key-value data, kept with the session and read back as sent.

offer.description:
What the subscription it creates is given beside its plan: the plan's start offer when
left out, unless the customer already had it.

option.description: The option's alias; the first the currency sells when left out.

plan.description: The plan, by code or id.

quantities.description: The starting count of each managed quantity its seat charges count, by code.

resource.description:
A stored resource of the customer the subscription is for, `{"id": …}` or
`{"type": …, "key": …}`; the whole customer when left out.

start_date.description: When billing starts; the day it is paid when left out.

success_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL the customer is sent to once paid, `checkout_session_id` appended.

trial.description:
The trial the subscription it creates starts with; the plan's when left out, unless the
customer already had it.

version.description: A published version's number; the active one when left out.

CreateCoupon.description: A coupon to create. Its code, redemption limit and `reusable` never change after.

applies_to.description: The plans and add-ons it may be redeemed with; anything when left out.

code.description: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`, unique among live coupons ignoring case.

duration.description: Forever when left out; `months` otherwise (`invoices` is refused).

eligibility.description: Who may redeem it; anyone with the code when left out.

redemption_limit.description: How many subscriptions may redeem it, 1 at least; no limit when left out.

valid_from.description: Not redeemable before; before `expires_at` when both are sent.

CreateCreditGrant.description: Credit granted without charging or invoicing.

amount.description: Positive, in minor units of the currency, or of `credit_unit`.

applies_to.description: What the credit pays; `all` by default.

cost.description:
Required for paid credit in a credit unit. Paid currency credit costing less than its
amount is granted as paid for the cost and promotional for the rest (`bonus_grant`).

credit_unit.description: A credit unit (its code) instead of a currency; its credit pays any charge.

currency.description: The customer's currency when left out (and no `credit_unit`).

expires_at.description: Unspent credit lapses then; never when left out.

priority.description: 100 by default; lower is drawn first.

products.description: Only these products' charges, by code or id; every product when left out.

reference.description:
Your own reference; required for paid credit costing more than zero when the customer's
invoicing entity is French (the invoice or receipt of its payment).

subscription.description:
The subscription it belongs to, by id or external id: it pays only that subscription's
charges, and lapses when it ends.

type.description:
`promotional` gives credit; `paid` records credit the customer paid for outside of
Meteroid (nothing is charged nor invoiced). Sell credit with a top-up.

CreateCreditUnit.description: A credit unit to create, with its product and prices.

code.description: 4 to 16 characters A-Z, 0-9 or `_`, starting with a letter (upper-cased); immutable.

name.description: What one unit is called ("Credit"), at most 64 characters.

plural_name.description: What several units are called ("Credits"), at most 64 characters.

precision.description: Decimal places of an amount in the unit, 0 to 6; immutable.

prices.description: The price of one unit per currency (`{"EUR": "0.01"}`).

product.description: The product its sales are booked under, by code or id.

symbol.description: Printed beside amounts in the unit, at most 8 characters; blank reads as none.

CreateCustomer.description:
A customer as written: the body of `POST /customers`, and what a merge patch of
`PATCH /customers/{id_or_alias}` applies to.

alias.description:
The integrator's own id, unique per tenant (`409` when another customer has it); paths
then take `ext:<alias>`. Not blank.

billing_address.description: The address printed on its invoices; an individual needs one with a `country`.

currency.description: One of the tenant's currencies (ISO 4217), read in upper case.

custom_properties.description:
Values of the tenant's customer properties, by key, checked against their definitions
(`GET /custom-property-definitions`).

first_name.description: The person's given name; required, with `last_name`, for an individual.

invoicing.description:
How its invoices are issued and sent; the tenant's default invoicing entity when left
out.

last_name.description: The person's family name; required, with `first_name`, for an individual.

name.description:
Required for a company, 1 to 255 characters; a person's is made of `first_name` and
`last_name`.

phone.description: The customer's phone number, kept as written.

tax.description: How the customer is taxed; taxable, with no identifier, when left out.

type.description: A company or a person; `company` by default.

CreateEntitlementOverride.description:
A customer's override: a row on the customer, or with `resource` for one of its stored
resources only. `effect` is `raise_to` by default, so a plan granting more still wins.

effect.description:
`raise_to` (the default), `set` or `cap_at`. A text, json or unordered select value
takes `set` only.

feature.description: The feature, by code or id.

level.description: Left out, the feature's level: per resource of its `applies_per`, else the customer.

policy.description: A limit's `set` override only: its own policy, in place of the feature's.

resource.description:
A stored resource of the customer, `{"id": …}` or `{"type": …, "key": …}`: the override
applies to it alone.

resource_type.description: With `level: resource_type`: the type, by code or id.

CreateFeature.description: A feature to create, with its default rows.

applies_per.description:
A resource type, by code or id, for a value per resource (per site); none: the customer
as a whole.

code.description: Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter or a digit; at most 128.

defaults.description:
The default rows, each naming this feature (its code): what every customer gets before
any plan applies.

product.description: The product it belongs to, by code or id; none: every product's.

CreateInvoice.description: A one-off invoice, written by hand: billed beside any subscription.

currency.description: ISO 4217; the customer's when left out.

custom_properties.description: Validated against the tenant's invoice custom property definitions.

due_date.description: Its net terms from the day it is issued when left out.

lines.description: One at least, each with its `name`, `quantity` and `unit_price` (no `id`).

memo.description: A note printed on the invoice.

purchase_order.description: The customer's purchase order number, printed on the invoice.

code.description: Lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`, 64 at most; unique per tenant, immutable.

aggregation_key.description: The event property aggregated; required but for a count.

attributed_to.description: The customer's own subscriptions when left out.

breakdown_by.description:
The event property each invoice line is broken down by, still priced on its total; refused
(`403`) when usage breakdowns are not in the organization's plan.

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; the event code, made unique (`-2`, `-3`…), when left out.

event_code.description:
The code the usage events it reads carry, immutable; `code` when left out. Several metrics
may read one. One of `code` and `event_code` is sent at least.

family.description: The product family, by code or id; the default family when left out.

filters.description: Only the events matching every one count; all of them when empty.

group_by.description:
The event property whose values are billed as lines of their own, each priced alone.
Immutable.

product.description: The product it measures, by code or id.

unit_conversion.description: Usage divided by a factor and rounded before it is priced; none by default.

unit_plural.description: What several units are called (`tokens`); sent with `unit_singular`.

unit_singular.description: What one unit is called (`token`); sent with `unit_plural`.

CreatePlan.description: A plan to create, with its first version as a draft.

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; the name's slug when left out.

family.description: The product family, by code or id; the default family when left out.

sold_for.description: The resource type its subscriptions are for, by code or id; none: the customer.

CreatePortalToken.description: The token asked for; the body may be left out (a day, every scope).

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds, 60 to 2592000 (30 days); a day by default.

resource.description:
The one resource a browser holding the token may check and read the entitlements of
(`{"id": …}` or `{"type": …, "key": …}`); without it, the customer only.

scopes.description:
Every scope by default; `["read"]` for a token that only reads, e.g. to gate features in
a browser.

CreateProduct.description: A product to create; it grants nothing until its features are made (`POST /features`).

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; the name's slug when left out.

family.description: The product family, by code or id, live; the default family when left out.

icon.description: A lucide icon name the dashboard ships (`box`, `cpu`, `users`…).

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; the name's slug when left out.

CreateRateCard.description: A card and what it rates, fixed once created; its rates are set with `PATCH …/rates`.

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit, by id, of a `credit_unit` card.

dimensions.description: One to four distinct event properties.

metric.description: The metric rated, by code or id: one that adds up (a sum or a count).

on_unmatched.description:
What usage no key matches does: `hold` (the default) keeps the invoice waiting until it
is rated, `ignore` leaves it unbilled.

unit_size.description: Rates are per this many units; 1 when left out.

code.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores (`site`); immutable.

keys.description:
At least one, the canonical first (`["site_id", "website_id"]`). A key another type holds
is `409 key_taken`.

CreateSubscription.description:
A subscription to create: a customer on a published version of a plan, in one of its
options, with its seats, levels, price overrides, own charges, add-ons and coupons.

activation.description: What starts it; `on_start` when left out.

add_ons.description: Add-ons bought with it, 100 at most.

billing_day_anchor.description: The day of the month periods start on, 1 to 31; the start date's when left out.

charges.description: How its charges differ from its plan's: prices overridden, charges added or left out.

currency.description:
Checked when sent: a subscription is sold in its customer's currency when the plan sells
it, else in the plan's.

custom_properties.description: Validated against the tenant's custom property definitions.

customer.description: The customer's id, or its alias as `ext:<alias>`.

end_date.description: The day it stops renewing and completes; it renews until cancelled when left out.

entitlement_overrides.description: The subscription's own entitlement rows, above its plan's (`set` only).

external_id.description:
The integrator's own id, unique per tenant, 1 to 255 bytes; paths take it in place of the
id. One taken answers `409 code_taken`.

levels.description:
The level of each usage-levels charge, by product code, as the usage it includes:
`{"api": "10000"}`. The lowest when left out.

offer.description:
What it is given beside its plan: the plan's start offer when left out, unless the
customer already had it.

option.description: The option's alias; the first the currency sells when left out.

plan.description: The plan, by code or id.

quantities.description: The starting count of each managed quantity its seat charges count, by code: `{"users": "12"}`.

resource.description:
A stored resource of the customer to subscribe for, `{"id": …}` or
`{"type": …, "key": …}`; the whole customer when left out.

start_date.description: The day it starts; today when left out. A past date bills the periods since.

trial.description: The plan's trial when left out, unless the customer already had it.

version.description: A published version's number; the active one when left out.

CreateTopUp.description: Credit sold to the customer, charged or invoiced. It is paid credit that pays any charge.

amount.description:
Credit bought, positive: minor units of the currency, sold one for one untaxed (the usage
it pays is taxed when invoiced); or minor units of `credit_unit`, sold at its price per
credit in the customer's currency, taxed under the unit's product.

collection.description: How it is paid; `charge` by default.

credit_unit.description: A credit unit (its code) to buy credit of, instead of a currency.

currency.description: The customer's currency when left out; `send_invoice` sells only in it.

expires_at.description: The credit bought lapses then; never when left out.

payment_method.description:
`charge` only, a payment method id; the customer's default when left out. Without one,
the answer carries a `checkout_url` where the customer pays.

unit_price.description:
With `credit_unit`: this purchase's price of one credit, a decimal string in major units
of the customer's currency; the customer's agreed price, else the list price, by default.

CreateWebhookEndpoint.description: An endpoint to create: where to POST, which event types, and the headers to send.

description.description: What the endpoint is for; blank reads as none.

event_types.description: As a payload's `type` names them; every event type but the beta ones when empty.

headers.description: Headers to send with every delivery.

rate_limit_per_sec.description: Deliveries started per second, at most: 1 to 1000; none by default.

url.description: HTTPS; private and loopback addresses are refused unless the instance allows them.

secret.description: The signing secret, `whsec_` and the base64 of 24 random bytes, as `WebhookSecret`'s.

CreatedWebhookEndpoint.description: The endpoint created, with its signing secret: read it again with `GET …/secret`.

CreditDiscount.description:
Credit added to the customer's balance when the subscription it is redeemed on starts; never
an invoice discount. Redeemed once per customer, its code matched whatever the case.

currency.description: The currency of the subscriptions that may redeem it.

expires_in_days.description: Days the credit stays spendable, 1 to 3660; none: it never expires.

CreditGrant.description: The credit one unit of a credit pack grants once paid.

amount.description:
Positive, a decimal string in the price's currency (major unit), or in `credit_unit`
when set.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit granted; none: credit in the price's currency.

expires_after.description: When the granted credit expires; none: never.

rollover.description: What is left at expiry carried into a new grant; none: nothing carries.

CreditGrantExpiredEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `CreditGrantExpiredEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

CreditGrantExpiredEventData.description: What was left of a grant lapsed: it expired, or the subscription it was for ended.

expired_amount.description: In minor units of the wallet.

CreditGrantId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cgr_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CreditGrantUpdatedEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `CreditGrantUpdatedEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

CreditGrantUpdatedEventData.description:
A grant not in effect yet was dated again, as the trial its offer counts from moved; no credit
moved.

effective_at.description: When its credit becomes usable, as dated again.

expires_at.description: When its credit expires, as dated again; absent when it never does.

CreditMoney.description: An amount in minor units of its currency.

amount.description: In minor units of `currency`.

CreditNote.description:
A credit note, its amounts in minor units of its currency and negative, as it gives back.
Lists carry what the note itself holds; `lines` are read on a single one.

credited.description: Of the total, what went to the customer's credit balance (positive).

currency.description: ISO 4217, its invoice's.

custom_properties.description: Values of the tenant's credit note properties, by key.

customer_details.description: The customer as the note prints it.

debt_cancelled.description: Of the total, the invoice's debt it cancelled (positive).

einvoicing_status.description: Whether the structured e-invoice was produced; none when e-invoicing was off.

files.description: Which of its files (PDF, e-invoice XML) are ready to download.

id.description: The credit note's id.

lines.description: Its lines, as issued; read on a single note, absent from lists.

refunded.description: Of the total, what was refunded in money (positive).

subscription.description: The subscription its invoice bills; absent for a one-off invoice's.

taxes.description: Its tax, one entry per rate.

type.description: How the credited amount goes back to the customer.

CreditNoteEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `CreditNote`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

CreditNoteId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `crn_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CreditNoteList.description: A page of `CreditNote` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

CreditNoteOrigin.description:
Who issued it, and why: `manual`, an operator's goodwill credit; `correction`, an operator
correcting what was billed; `amendment`, `plan_change` and `cancellation`, Meteroid for a
subscription change it settled; `late_pack`, a credit pack billed late, given back;
`unapplied_change`, a scheduled change that did not apply, given back; `void`, its invoice
voided.

CreditNoteRef.description: A credit note named by another resource.

id.description: The credit note's id.

CreditNoteStatus.description:
Where a credit note is: `draft`, not issued yet, its credit not applied; `finalized`, issued,
its credit applied as its `type` says; `voided`, cancelled.

CreditNoteType.description:
How the credited amount goes back to the customer: `credit_to_balance`, to the customer's
credit balance, drawn on later invoices; `refund`, refunded in money; `debt_cancellation`,
what the invoice still owed, cancelled.

CreditUnit.description:
A denomination usage is priced and credit granted in instead of money, with its selling price
per currency.

archived.description: No new price, pack or grant may use it; what uses it keeps working.

code.description: 4 to 16 characters A-Z, 0-9 or `_`, starting with a letter; immutable.

precision.description: Decimal places of an amount in the unit, 0 to 6; immutable.

prices.description: The price of one unit per currency, in its major unit.

product.description:
The product its sales are booked under (tax category, accounting code); none: the unit is
not sold.

symbol.description: Printed beside amounts in the unit, at most 8 characters.

CreditUnitId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cun_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CreditUnitList.description: A page of `CreditUnit` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

CreditUnitRef.description: A credit unit named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

CreditedLine.description: An invoice line credited, by exactly one of `quantity`, `amount` and `sub_lines`.

amount.description:
An amount credited before tax, in minor units, at most what is left of the line: for a
line no unit price expresses (a minimum's shortfall, usage priced in credits).

line.description: The invoice line, by its `id` (`lines[].id` of the invoice).

quantity.description:
Units credited at the line's unit price; a line priced by tiers, a volume or a package
credits what its model priced less what it prices the units kept.

sub_lines.description: Sub-lines credited; the line's other sub-lines are not.

CreditedSubLine.description: A sub-line of an invoice line credited: how many of its units.

quantity.description: Units of the sub-line credited, positive, as a decimal string.

sub_line.description: The sub-line, by its `id` (`lines[].sub_lines[].id` of the invoice).

CurrentPeriod.description: The billing period the subscription is in.

end.description: Exclusive; none for a subscription not billed by period yet.

CustomPropertyConfig.description: What a value is checked against; only the fields of the property's type are read.

max.description: The upper bound of a `number`, inclusive.

CustomPropertyDefinition.description:
A custom property: the key a resource's `custom_properties` holds its value under, and what
that value may be.

archived.description: Archived: no longer checked on writes; the values held are kept.

archived_at.description: When it was archived; absent on a live definition.

config.description: What a value is checked against, beside its type.

default_value.description: The value a resource created without one gets.

display_order.description: Where the dashboard shows it, lowest first.

entity_type.description: The resource it applies to; immutable.

id.description: The definition's id.

key.description: Unique among the live definitions of its entity type, immutable.

name.description: The property's name, as the dashboard shows it.

required.description: A resource of its type is refused without a value.

updated_at.description: When it last changed; absent when it never did.

CustomPropertyDefinitionId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cpd_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CustomPropertyDefinitionList.description: A page of `CustomPropertyDefinition` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

CustomPropertyEntity.description: The resource a definition applies to.

CustomPropertyOption.description: A choice of a `single_select` or `multi_select` property.

label.description: Shown in place of the value.

value.description: The value a resource holds when it is chosen.

CustomPropertyType.description:
What a property's value is: `text`, `number`, `boolean`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `datetime`
(RFC 3339), `single_select` (one of `config.options`), `multi_select` (some of them), `json`
(any JSON value), `url` or `email`.

CustomTaxRate.description: A tax rate applied to this customer's invoices in place of the computed ones.

name.description: The tax's name, printed on the invoice (`VAT`, `GST`).

rate.description: A fraction as a decimal string: `"0.2"` is 20%.

tax_code.description: The tax's accounting code, kept on the invoice's tax breakdown.

CustomTrial.description:
A trial of its own terms: `days` or an end date `until` (exclusive), one of them. It bills
nothing and converts at its end.

features_of.description: The plan whose features it gives, by code or id; the plan's trial's when left out.

until.description: After the billing start, 3,650 days at most.

Customer.description: A customer: who is billed, in one currency, with its addresses, tax and invoicing settings.

alias.description: The integrator's own id, unique per tenant; paths take it as `ext:<alias>`.

archived.description: Archived: kept, with what is linked to it, but left out of lists unless asked.

archived_at.description: When it was archived; absent on a live customer.

billing_address.description: The address printed on its invoices, which its tax is computed from.

currency.description: What the customer is billed in (ISO 4217).

custom_properties.description: Values of the tenant's customer properties, by key.

first_name.description: The person's given name; with `last_name`, an individual's name.

id.description: The customer's id; paths take it, or the alias as `ext:<alias>`.

invoicing.description: How the customer's invoices are issued and sent.

last_name.description: The person's family name; with `first_name`, an individual's name.

name.description: A company's name, or a person's full name.

phone.description: The customer's phone number, as written.

tax.description: How the customer is taxed, and the identifiers its invoices carry.

CustomerCreditGrant.description: A lot of credit given to or bought by the customer.

amount.description: Credit granted, in minor units of `currency` or `credit_unit`.

applies_to.description: What the credit pays, combined with `products`.

bonus_grant.description:
On the response that created paid credit costing less than its amount: the promotional
grant made beside it for the difference.

cost.description: What the whole grant was paid, net of tax.

cost_basis.description: `cost` per one credit, in major units of its currency (`"0.008"`).

credit_note.description: The credit note that gave the credit back.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit its amounts are in; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

currency.description: The currency of its amounts (ISO 4217); absent for a credit unit grant.

effective_at.description: When the credit became, or becomes, spendable.

ended_at.description:
When the subscription it belongs to ended: unspent credit lapses then, even before
`expires_at`.

expired_amount.description: Lost to expiry; present only on an expired grant.

expires_at.description: When unspent credit lapses; absent when it never does.

id.description: The grant's id.

invoice.description: The invoice that sold the credit, or whose void or negative total gave it back.

kind.description: The group the grant is shown in.

kind_label.description: The group's name as shown: "Included with Pro", "Purchased credit"…

priority.description: Lower is drawn first among grants paying the same charges.

products.description: The products whose charges it pays; empty for every product.

reference.description: Your own reference, e.g. a contract or support ticket.

remaining.description: Not spent yet, in the same minor units.

subscription.description: The subscription it belongs to: it pays that subscription's charges only.

type.description: Whether it applies after tax (`paid`) or before (`promotional`).

CustomerCreditGrantList.description: A page of `CustomerCreditGrant` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

CustomerEntitlement.description: A feature as the customer may use it.

applies_per.description: The resource type the feature applies per; none: the customer.

product.description: The product the feature belongs to; none for a feature of the whole catalog.

unit.description: What a number or a limit counts.

value.description: The primary level's value, capped by the other levels; absent: not entitled.

warnings.description: `usage_unavailable`: a level's usage could not be read, its `used` is absent.

CustomerEntitlementRead.description: One feature as the customer may use it, read alone.

CustomerEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `Customer`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

previous_attributes.description: On `customer.updated` and `subscription.updated`: what the change replaced. Absent when it replaced none of the attributes listed there.

CustomerId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cus_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CustomerInvoicing.description: How the customer's invoices are issued and sent.

buyer_reference.description: The reference the customer routes invoices by (a Leitweg-ID), BT-10 of an e-invoice.

preferred_locales.description: Document languages, most preferred first (BCP 47); empty follows the invoicing entity.

CustomerInvoicingInput.description: How the customer's invoices are issued and sent, as written; every field may be left out.

buyer_reference.description: The reference the customer routes invoices by (a Leitweg-ID), BT-10 of an e-invoice.

emails.description: Where invoices are sent, beside `email`; blank ones are dropped.

entity.description: The invoicing entity, by id; the tenant's default when left out.

preferred_locales.description:
BCP 47 tags, most preferred first; one at least must be a language invoices are rendered
in.

CustomerKind.description:
A company, or a person (B2C): a person is named by `first_name` and `last_name`, and needs a
billing country. `company`: a business, named by `name` (the default); `individual`: a person,
whose `name` is made of `first_name` and `last_name`.

CustomerList.description: A page of `Customer` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

CustomerPaymentMethodId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `pm_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CustomerRef.description: A customer named by another resource.

alias.description: The integrator's own id of the customer; name it as `ext:<alias>` in requests.

id.description: The customer's id.

CustomerTax.description: How the customer is taxed, and the identifiers its invoices carry.

custom_rates.description:
Tax rates applied to the customer's invoices in place of the computed ones; empty when
the computed ones apply.

exemption_reason.description: The legal mention printed on an exempt customer's invoices.

legal_number.description: The national register identifier (SIREN/SIRET, HRB…), BT-47 of an e-invoice.

status.description: How the customer's invoices are taxed.

vat_number.description: The customer's VAT or tax identification number, printed on its invoices.

vat_number_status.description: The VIES check of `vat_number`; absent when there is none to check.

CustomerTaxInput.description: How the customer is taxed, as written; every field may be left out.

custom_rates.description:
Tax rates applied to the customer's invoices in place of the computed ones; none by
default.

exemption_reason.description: The legal mention printed on an exempt customer's invoices.

legal_number.description: The national register identifier (SIREN/SIRET, HRB…), BT-47 of an e-invoice.

status.description: How the customer's invoices are taxed; `taxable` by default.

vat_number.description: The customer's VAT or tax identification number; an EU one is checked with VIES.

Dates.description: The subscription's dates. Days are ISO 8601 dates, moments RFC 3339.

activated_at.description:
When it was first activated (its start, its checkout or a manual activation); absent
before.

billing_start.description: When it is billed from: its start, after a free trial.

end.description: When it ends; none: until cancelled.

start.description: When its benefits start, a trial included.

DecidingCandidate.description: A subscription including the feature at the level, with the value its rows give there.

resource.description: The resource it is for; absent for a subscription of the customer as a whole.

DeletedInvoice.description: The draft invoice `invoice.deleted` is about: it is gone, so only its id is known.

DeletedInvoiceEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `DeletedInvoice`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

DeliveryStatus.description: Where a delivery is in its retry cycle.

Denomination.description:
What a card's rates are in: `money`, a rate per currency on each key; `credit_unit`, rates in
the card's one credit unit.

DenominationInput.description:
What a card's rates are in: `money` (the default), a rate per currency on each key;
`credit_unit`, rates in the card's `credit_unit`.

DimensionRate.description: A rate of a dimension rates price: the usage whose dimensions match `key`, at `unit_price`.

key.description:
A pattern per dimension, in the order of the price's `dimensions`: a value, a prefix
ending in `*`, or `*`. Two rates never share a key.

label.description: A name for the rate, kept with it.

unit_price.description: Per `unit_size` units, a decimal string in the currency's major unit.

DimensionRatesModel.description: Usage rated by its dimensions at rates the price holds, the most specific key winning.

dimensions.description: The usage event properties the rates are keyed by, in key order: 1 to 4.

on_unmatched.description: What happens to usage no rate matches; `hold` when left out.

unit_size.description: Rates are per this many units (1000000: per 1M tokens).

Direction.description:
Which way a change goes: `downgrade` when any part of it gets less (a cheaper fee, less
credit, a shorter cadence, fewer seats, a lower level; a cancellation is one); `upgrade` when
a part gets more and none less; `lateral` when none changes either way.

Document.description: A document a change issues, its amounts in minor units, its lines as an invoice's read.

amount_due.description: What is left to pay once the customer's credit applies, in minor units.

coupons.description: The coupons it applies; absent when none.

discount.description: What discounts and coupons take off, in minor units.

lines.description: Its lines, as an invoice's read.

subtotal.description: The lines' total before discounts, credit and tax, in minor units.

taxes.description: Its tax by rate; absent when it has none.

total.description: The total, tax included, in minor units.

amount.description: What it took off, in minor units, before tax.

coupon.description: The coupon applied; none for a discount an offer gives without a code.

DocumentCustomer.description:
The customer a document is addressed to, as printed: as issued, or the live customer on a
draft. The customer itself is the document's `customer`.

alias.description: The integrator's own id of the customer; name it as `ext:<alias>` in requests.

id.description: The customer's id.

name.description: A company's name, or a person's full name.

DocumentFiles.description: The files of an issued document.

pdf.description: The PDF is ready: `GET …/pdf`. Generated after the document is issued, so not at once.

xml.description: The structured e-invoice (EN 16931 XML) is ready: `GET …/xml`.

DocumentLine.description: A line of a document, as it was billed.

amount.description: In minor units, before discounts and tax.

billing.description: How the charge it bills recurs; absent on a line written by hand.

credits.description: The credit unit its usage is priced in, and what the customer's credits covered.

description.description: Printed under its name; absent when blank.

dimensions.description: The values of the dimensions a usage line is grouped by.

end_date.description: The day after the last it bills: the period is `[start_date, end_date)`.

id.description:
Its id within its document: a credit note names the invoice lines it credits by it, and a
draft's edit the lines it keeps. A preview's lines have ids of their own, never issued.

name.description: As printed: the charge's name, or the name a line written by hand was given.

product.description: The product billed; absent on a line written by hand.

prorated.description: Billed for part of its period only (a change mid-period, a first period started late).

quantity.description: Absent on a line its `sub_lines` add up (tiers, packages, dimension rates).

start_date.description: The first day the line bills.

sub_lines.description: Tiers, packages or dimension rates the line adds up.

tax.description: The tax on `taxable_amount`, in minor units.

tax_rate.description: A fraction as a decimal string: `"0.2"` is 20%.

taxable_amount.description: What is taxed of `amount`, discounts and promotional credit taken off.

unit_price.description: In the currency's major unit; absent as `quantity` is.

DocumentTax.description: One rate of the document's tax.

amount.description: The tax at this rate, in minor units.

exemption.description: Why the rate is 0; absent on a tax applied.

exemption_reason.description: The legal mention of the exemption.

rate.description: A fraction as a decimal string: `"0.2"` is 20%.

taxable_amount.description:
What the rate applies to, in minor units: negative where credit or proration lines net
below zero.

DocumentType.description:
What a document a change issues is: `invoice` the prorated charges, issued when the change
applies; `credit_note` the unused time given back, issued when it applies, its amounts
negative; `next_invoice` the next renewal, under the change.

DynamicModel.description:
The amount the metric sums, in major units of the price currency (12.34, not 1234), billed
as is: each event carries its own price.

EInvoicingStatus.description:
Whether the structured e-invoice was produced with the PDF: `generated`, or `failed` when
the document did not satisfy the standard (the PDF was issued all the same).

Entitlement.description:
A value given to a feature by its owner (a plan version, an add-on, a subscription, a
customer override or the feature's defaults). Editing a row keeps its id: the edit becomes a
new version, and `GET /entitlements/{id}/history` lists them all.

condition.description:
`{"<type>.<attribute>": [values]}`: the row applies only where each attribute holds one
of its values.

created_at.description: When the row was first written.

level.description:
Where the value applies. A row written without `level` reads at its feature's level
(`applies_per`).

policy.description: A `set` row's own policy for its limit, in place of the feature's.

resource.description: A customer's override for one of its stored resources only.

revoked_at.description: When this version stopped applying: replaced by an edit, or revoked.

EntitlementCheck.description: Whether the customer may use `requested` more of a feature now: every level must allow.

as_of.description:
When the usage the answer uses was counted: now, or, while usage cannot be read, the
last live count (`usage_source: live`).

attributes_ignored.description:
Attributes the request asserted that the stored resource holds other values of: the
stored ones were used.

in_overage.description: The request goes past a limit that allows usage past it and bills it: allowed, and billed.

near_limit.description:
A level is within 5% of a limit that refuses, or past it: check before every use, and do
not cache an answer that allows.

remaining.description: Left before the limit, not counting its grace.

retry_at.description:
When a refusal may lift: the latest reset among the refusing levels when each is a limit
that resets, or 30 seconds ahead when usage could not be read.

used.description:
`used`, `limit` and `remaining` are the refusing level's, else the primary level's; absent
without a limit.

value.description: The primary level's value, capped by the other levels.

warnings.description: `usage_unavailable`: a level's usage could not be read, its `used` is absent.

EntitlementEffect.description:
How a row combines with the value of the owners before it: the feature's defaults, then the
plan and its version, the subscription, its add-ons and the customer's overrides, in that
order.

EntitlementHistory.description: A page of `Entitlement` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

EntitlementId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `ent_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

EntitlementInput.description:
A row written on its owner. A row read back can be sent as is: its read-only fields are
ignored.

effect.description:
Left out, the owner's usual one: `set` on a feature's defaults, a plan version and a
subscription; `add` on an add-on bought in several instances, `raise_to` on another
add-on and on a customer override.

feature.description: The feature, by code or id.

id.description: Read-only: ignored.

level.description:
Left out, the feature's level: per resource of its `applies_per` type, else the customer.
Set it for a value at another level, e.g. a cap across all sites on a feature per site.

resource_type.description: With `level: resource_type`: the type, by code or id.

EntitlementLevel.description: A feature at one level: the customer as a whole, or the resource the request names.

deciding_subscription.description: The subscription whose value applies here, when several include the feature.

policy.description: A limit's policy: the feature's, or the one a `set` row gives in its place.

primary.description:
The level the feature applies per (`applies_per`, else the customer): its value is the
feature's, and none there means not entitled. The other levels can only cap it.

resource.description: With `level: resource_type`: the resource this level is for.

used.description:
A limit's usage: the count your app reported, or the metric's events for this level over
`window`. Absent when it could not be read (warning `usage_unavailable`).

value.description:
Absent on the primary level: not entitled (`reason` tells when a resource is needed).
Absent on another level: nothing caps the value there.

EntitlementOverrideList.description: A page of `Entitlement` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

name.description: The plan and version's, the add-on's or the customer's name, where known.

EntitlementSnapshot.description:
Every feature with its levels. `etag` is also the `ETag` header: sent back as
`If-None-Match`, it answers `304` while the values are the same (usage is not part of it).

attributes_ignored.description:
Attributes the request asserted that the stored resource holds other values of: the
stored ones were used.

warnings.description: `usage_unavailable`: a level's usage could not be read, its `used` is absent.

EntitlementTier.description:
Where a row sits in the order rows apply in, first to last: the feature's defaults, the
