plan, the plan version, the subscription, its add-ons, the customer's override, and an
override for one resource.

EntitlementValue.description:
The value a row gives, of the feature's type. A boolean takes `on` or `off`. A limit takes
`limit`, `unlimited` or `off`: `off` means not entitled at all, while a limit of 0 is
entitled to none. A value feature takes `number`, `text` (also a select's option) or `json`.

EntityActivityId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `act_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

EstimateUsage.description: An event to price without ingesting it.

code.description: The event code (`api_calls`): every metric of this code the subscription bills prices it.

properties.description: As ingested: what metrics filter, group and aggregate by.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, within the subscription's current period; now when left out.

id.description: Its prefixed id; absent for `system`.

EventActorType.description: Who changed something: a user, the customer, an API key, an OAuth app, or Meteroid itself.

EventCost.description:
An event's cost at the price in force, unrounded: a decimal string in the currency's (or the
credit unit's) major unit.

amount.description: In the major unit of `currency` or `credit_unit`.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit, for usage priced in credit.

currency.description: ISO 4217, for a cost in money; absent beside `credit_unit`.

EventId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `evt_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

EventPropertyValue.description:
A property's value: a string, a number or a boolean. Metering keeps every value as text: a
number as written (`1048576`, `0.25`; send a string to keep a value past 2^64 or 17
significant digits exact), a boolean as `true` or `false`. `null`, an object or an array is
refused.

EventType.description:
An event type, as a payload's `type` names it: the resource and what happened to it
(`invoice.paid`).

Expiry.description:
When granted credit expires: so many days or months after it is granted, or at the end of
the period invoiced.

unit.description: Days, months, or the billing period.

value.description: How many days or months; required with them, refused with `billing_period`.

ExpiryUnit.description:
What an expiry counts in: `days`, `months`, or `billing_period` (at the end of the period
invoiced, without a `value`).

ExtendTrial.description: A trial's new end, later than its current one: a day, or days added to its end. One of the two.

days.description: Days added to the current end, at least one.

Feature.description:
What a customer may use: on or off, a value or a limit, checked by its `code` and granted by
its default rows and those of plans, add-ons, subscriptions and customers.

applies_per.description:
The resource type it applies per (each site has its own value); none: the customer as a
whole. A customer is entitled only where a row gives a value at this level.

code.description: What an application checks; unique among live features, immutable.

defaults.description: The feature's default rows: what every customer gets before any plan applies.

product.description: The product it belongs to; none: every product's.

unit.description: What a number or a limit counts (`projects`, `requests per minute`).

FeatureId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `feat_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

FeatureList.description: A page of `Feature` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

FeatureRef.description: A feature named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

FeatureStatus.description:
Where a feature is: `active`, entitling as its rows say; `disabled`, entitling no one, its
rows kept; `archived`, hidden with its rows until unarchived, its code free for another
feature.

FeatureType.description: What a feature is. Its type, `value_type`, `counted_by` and `metric` are fixed once created.

FieldError.description: A field the request was refused for.

code.description: Why the field is refused.

message.description: What is wrong with it, in English, for a person to read; it may change at any time.

path.description:
JSON pointer into the request body (`/charges/0/prices/1/model`), or the parameter or
header name (`limit`, `Idempotency-Key`).

FieldErrorCode.description:
Why a field is refused. New codes may be added without a new `Meteroid-Version`: a client
reads one it does not know as `invalid`.

Filter.description:
Only the events whose `property` matches count. Filters are ANDed; a negation (`not_equal`,
`not_in`) leaves out an event without the property.

property.description: The event property compared, not blank.

values.description: The values compared with, one at least.

FilterOp.description:
How a filter compares an event's property with its `values`: `equal` and `in` keep an event
whose property is one of them, `not_equal` and `not_in` one whose property is none of them.

FirstChargeEstimate.description:
What the trial's end is estimated to charge first: the opening invoice billed from its end,
with coupons and tax as they stand and before any usage. An estimate: usage, coupons and tax
may change it.

amount.description: In minor units of `currency`.

on.description: The day it is charged: the trial's end.

FixedDiscount.description: An amount off each invoice it discounts, in the subscription's currency.

amount.description: In the major unit of `currency`.

amounts.description: The amount in other currencies, by ISO 4217 code: a subscription in a currency with no amount cannot redeem it.

FixedQuantity.description: A count set on the plan: the same for every subscription.

value.description: A whole number of units, 1 or more.

FixedWindowReset.description: Every `interval` `unit`s, counted from the subscription's start.

FlatModel.description: One amount, whatever the quantity (which is 1).

amount.description: A decimal string in the currency's major unit.

ForeverDuration.description: Every billing period of the subscription.

GraduatedModel.description: Each unit priced by the tier it falls in.

tiers.description: 1 to 100 tiers, the first starting at unit 0, ascending.

GrantEndReason.description:
Why a grant ended: `withdrawn` its subscription never started; `subscription_ended` its
subscription ended; `window_ended` its window is over.

GrantEndedEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `GrantEndedEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

GrantEndedEventData.description: A grant of an offer applied to a subscription ended: its window over, or before it.

grant.description: The grant, as the subscription's `grants` name it.

oneOf.description: What it gave; absent for a kind this version does not know.

GrantKind.description:
The group a grant is shown in: `included` (credit a plan includes, renewed with it),
`prepaid` (credit bought), `bonus` (credit given) or `account_balance` (the customer's money
that pays any invoice: credit notes, returned invoices, the balance from before grants).

GrantSource.description:
Where the credit came from: `manual` (granted by hand or through the API), `purchase` (a
top-up, an automatic top-up, a credit purchase or a plan's paid credit pack), `plan`
(included with a subscription's plan), `credit_note` (given back by a credit note),
`adjustment` (returned by a negative or voided invoice), `migrated` (the balance that
preceded credit grants), `rollover` (unspent included credit carried over when it expired),
`coupon` (redeemed with a promotional credit coupon) or `overpayment` (money collected above
what an invoice asked).

GrantStatus.description:
Where a grant is: `pending` until its `effective_at`, then `active`, `depleted` once spent,
or `expired` once lapsed.

GrantType.description:
`paid` credit was bought and applies after tax, like a payment; `promotional` credit was given
and applies before tax, like a discount.

Granularity.description: How long a cost bucket is: an hour, a day or a calendar month, cut at UTC boundaries.

IdempotentReplay.description: What a marker says of the first response: it was not kept.

IdempotentReplayMarker.description:
What a retry with an `Idempotency-Key` replays when the first response was not kept (larger
than 512 KB, or holding a secret): its write was made and never runs again; read the resource
for its result, by `id` when the first response named one.

detail.description: Why the response was not kept, and how to read the result, for a person to read.

id.description:
The `id` of the first response, when it was a JSON object with one: the resource the
write created or changed.

idempotent_replay.description: `response_not_kept`: what tells a marker from the response it stands for.

status.description: The first response's status, which the replay answers with too.

IncludedBy.description:
Which subscriptions include a feature: the customer's (its value holds for the whole
customer), or only its resources' (it is answered per resource: name one).

code.description: The event code (`api_calls`): every metric of this `event_code` reads the event.

customer.description: The customer: its Meteroid id, or its alias as `ext:<alias>`.

event_id.description:
1 to 255 characters; a UUID or ULID is recommended. An event is deduplicated by its
`event_id` and `customer`: the first copy received is kept, later copies are ignored.

properties.description: What metrics filter, group and aggregate by.

timestamp.description:
RFC 3339; the time it is received when left out. Between 24 hours ago and 1 hour from
now, or up to 13 months ago with `allow_backfilling`.

IngestEvents.description: Events to ingest, 1 to 500 (the body 1 MB at most).

allow_backfilling.description: Accept timestamps up to 13 months in the past, not 24 hours. `false` by default.

allow_partial_failures.description:
Ingest the accepted events of a batch some events are rejected from, and answer which
were. `false` by default: one rejected event refuses the whole batch (`422`).

IngestEventsResult.description: What became of a batch: every event not in `rejected` is accepted.

accepted.description:
How many events were accepted. A copy of an event already received counts: it is
ignored when stored.

rejected.description: The events rejected, in the batch's order; empty when none is.

IngestRejection.description: An event a batch was ingested without.

path.description:
A JSON pointer to what is refused: the event (`/events/3`) or one of its fields
(`/events/3/customer`).

Invoice.description:
An invoice, its amounts in minor units of its currency. Lists carry what the invoice itself
holds; `lines`, `payments` and `credit_notes` are read on a single one.

amount_paid.description: What payments (and credit notes cancelling its debt) settled of it.

applied_credits.description: Paid credit drawn on it, after tax.

carried_balance.description: Debts carried in from earlier invoices, less a debt it carried to a later one.

consolidated_into.description: The consolidated invoice this draft was merged into, which bills it in its place.

corrected_by.description: The invoice reissued in place of this one.

corrects.description: The invoice this one corrects (cancelled by a credit note and reissued as this one).

created_at.description: When it was created, as a draft or issued at once.

credit_notes.description: The credit notes issued against it: `GET /api/v2/credit-notes/{id}`.

currency.description: ISO 4217: every amount of the invoice is in its minor units.

custom_properties.description: Values of the tenant's invoice properties, by key.

customer_details.description: The customer as the invoice prints it.

discount.description: What coupons and discounts took off, before tax.

due_date.description:
When it is due: `invoice_date` plus `net_terms`, unless set by hand; absent on a draft
whose due date is computed when it is issued.

einvoicing_status.description: Whether the structured e-invoice was produced; none when e-invoicing was off.

files.description: Which of its files (PDF, e-invoice XML) are ready to download.

id.description: The invoice's id, `inv_…`.

invoice_date.description: When it is issued; a draft's, the date finalizing it today would stamp.

lines.description: Its lines, as issued; read on a single invoice, absent from lists.

memo.description: A note printed on the invoice.

net_terms.description: Days it is due after it is issued.

number.description:
Its number as printed, from the invoicing entity's sequence when it is finalized; `draft`
until then.

paid_at.description: When it was paid in full.

payments.description: Its payments and refunds, by when they were processed (those not processed yet first).

period_start.description: The start of the period it bills, or its own date for an invoice of no period.

promotional_credits.description: Promotional credit taken off before tax.

purchase_order.description: The customer's purchase order number, printed on the invoice.

reference.description:
The payment reference a transfer quotes: the number's letters and digits, set when it is
finalized.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

subscription.description: The subscription it bills; absent on a one-off invoice.

tax_inclusive.description: Its prices were quoted tax included. Amounts are net all the same: the tax was carved out.

taxes.description: Its tax, one entry per rate.

updated_at.description:
When it last changed: any edit of a draft (its lines, its customer's details, its annexes),
its issue, its payment, its custom properties. What `updated_after` filters on.

InvoiceEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `Invoice`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

invoice the price includes the tax.

amount.description: In minor units.

Given back voluntarily, in minor units: the invoice stays paid, the refund's credit note
reduces it.

type.description: A payment, or a refund from one.

id.description: The invoice's id.

InvoiceStatus.description:
Where an invoice is in its life: `draft`, still computed, its lines following the usage until
it is finalized; `finalized`, issued; `uncollectible`, issued then written off; `void`, issued
then cancelled; `closed`, never issued (a period that settled with nothing to bill, or a draft
deleted).

InvoiceType.description:
Why an invoice was issued: `recurring`, a period of a subscription; `one_off`, by hand or
for a purchase; `adjustment`, what a subscription change billed at once (prorated seats, a
plan or level change…); `usage_threshold`, usage billed early, past its threshold; `final`,
what a subscription ended at once consumed after its period's own invoice.

Read only.

How the credit goes back: to the customer's balance (by default), refunded, or the
invoice's debt cancelled.

balance_after.description: The credit on account after it.

credit_note.description: The credit note that gave the credit back or removed it.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit its amounts are in; absent for a currency.

invoice.description: The invoice the credit was applied to or given back by.

What moved the credit: `credit` (granted), `invoice_application` (applied to a finalized
invoice), `invoice_return` (given back by a voided invoice or a credit note),
`credit_reversal` (removed by a credit note, by hand or by a reversed payment),
`credit_reinstatement` (restored once a reversed payment's money was recovered),
`credit_expiry` (lapsed unspent) or `credit_rollover` (carried out of an expiring grant into
the grant it rolled over to).

Level.description:
A level of a price sold in levels: a fee each period including some usage, with an overage
rate beyond it.

included.description: The usage the level includes each period.

overage_unit_price.description:
Per unit used beyond `included`, billed in arrears; a decimal string in the currency's
major unit.

price.description:
The level's fee each period, billed in advance; a decimal string in the currency's major
unit.

LevelExplain.description:
How a level's value was made: each row's part, the subscriptions that could decide it, and
the counts your app reported.

LevelKind.description:
Where a value applies: for the customer as a whole (across all its resources), or for each
resource of `resource_type` (per site).

LevelResource.description: The resource a level is for: its type's code and its key value.

LevelsModel.description: Levels a buyer picks between, fewest units first.

LevelsMore.description: Where the levels lead past their largest: sales.

plan_name.description: The sales-led plan of the ladder it leads to; none when it is the card's own.

metric.description: `events` only: the metric counted, by code (id or code on input).

per_unit_of.description:
A managed quantity, by code (id or code on input): the limit is then per unit a
subscription holds ("5 projects per seat"), as an add-on's rows count per instance.

policy.description:
Always read; on create, left out: `{resets: billing_cycle, at_limit: deny}` from events,
`{resets: never, at_limit: deny_new}` by the app.

LineBilling.description:
How the charge a line bills recurs: `recurring`, a fee every period (a rate, seats);
`usage`, what the period's usage billed; `one_time`, billed once.

LineCredits.description:
Usage priced in a credit unit: the line's money amounts carry only what the customer's
credits did not cover, billed at `rate`.

consumed.description: The credit the line's usage consumed, in 10^-`precision` credit.

covered.description: Of `consumed`, what the customer's credits paid.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit the usage is priced in.

precision.description: Credit amounts are integers in 10^-precision credit.

rate.description: The currency's major units per credit.

LineKind.description:
What a line bills: `charge`, what a charge billed; `minimum_shortfall`, what brings the
period up to the subscription's minimum; `credit`, credit sold, which paying the document
funds.

Listing.description:
How the plan reads on its product family's pricing page and self-serve ladder. Live, never
versioned.

contact_url.description: Where a sales-led plan's button leads.

cta_label.description: The label of the plan's button on the pricing page; none: the page's default.

hide_price.description: A sales-led plan's price stays off the page.

sales_led.description: Sold by contacting sales: on the page, never self-serve.

self_serve_rank.description: Its rung on the self-serve ladder (1 first); none: not offered self-serve.

tagline.description: A line under the plan's name on the pricing page.

Beta, on a subscription's current period only: what the usage adds so far to its next
invoice, before discounts and credits; empty while it bills nothing (a free trial).

groups.description: The usage by the values of the metric's dimensions.

projected_costs.description:
Beta: what `costs` would reach at that pace, each usage window priced whole as its invoice
prices it (tiers and volumes included). Usage priced in credit counts its credits: the
money billed once the wallet runs out is not projected.

Beta, on a subscription's current period only: `quantity` at its pace so far until the
period's end. A sum or a count grows linearly; a max, latest, mean or unique count is
projected as it stands. Each usage window is projected to its own end (a plan change or a
scheduled stop ends one), so this is what the invoice would bill. Absent until an hour and
5% of every window have elapsed, and while a window has not started.

quantity.description: The usage, aggregated as the metric aggregates.

amount.description: In minor units: `4900` is 49.00.

at its catalog price.

amount.description: Positive, in the major unit of `currency`.

offer.description: The offer, by id or code.

When an increase of a subscription's count takes effect: `immediately` (the default), billed
