PlanTrialTerms.description:
A plan's trial written as its terms: a free period before billing. What is left out is kept
from the plan's current trial (else the card required, `convert`, `await_payment`).

card.description: Whether sign-up, checkout and the pricing page ask for a card to start it.

features_of.description:
The plan whose features it gives over this one's, by code or id (a reverse trial on a
free plan); none: this plan's.

without_card.description:
What a converting end does if the subscription is charged automatically and has no
payment method then.

PlanType.description:
What kind of plan it is: `standard`, sold to anyone; `free`, subscribed without a payment
method; `custom`, negotiated for one customer.

PlanVersion.description:
A version of a plan: its options, charges, terms and rows. A published version never
changes; a change is written in the draft and published as the next version.

add_ons.description: The add-ons a subscription to the version may hold.

billing_cycles.description: How many periods a subscription runs; none: until cancelled.

charges.description: What the version bills, in the order written, each charge in its canonical composition.

currency.description: The version's default currency: its minimum's, and what it is shown in first.

minimum.description: A floor on what a subscription is billed each period; none: no floor.

net_terms.description: Days an invoice is due after it is issued.

number.description: 1 for the first version, counting up.

options.description: By position; the first is the default.

PlanVersionList.description: A page of `PlanVersionSummary` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

PlanVersionSummary.description:
A version of a plan as listed, without its charges: read it whole with
`GET /plans/{id_or_code}?version=<number>`.

created_at.description: When the version was first written, as a draft.

currency.description: The version's default currency (ISO 4217).

number.description: 1 for the first version, counting up.

Policy.description:
How a limit behaves: when its usage resets and what reaching it does. The feature holds it;
a `set` row may give one of its own.

grace_pct.description: `deny` only: how far past the limit usage is still allowed, in percent of the limit.

resets.description:
When the usage counted against the limit starts again from zero. A limit your app counts
never resets. `billing_cycle` follows the subscription; with none, each calendar month.

thresholds.description: Percents of the limit at which an alert is sent, at most 10.

PortalScope.description: What a portal token may do: `read` the customer's billing state, or `manage` it too.

PortalToken.description:
A token opening the customer portal. A call may return the token of an earlier one with the
same scopes, with up to 10% less lifetime: rely on `expires_at`.

api_url.description: The base URL of the API a browser calls with the token.

expires_at.description: When the token stops being accepted.

token.description: The bearer token the portal and the client API (`api_url`) take.

url.description: The hosted portal, the token included.

Preset.description:
Sugar for a common composition: it fills `quantity` and `timing`, and refuses an explicit one
contradicting it (`preset_conflict`). Responses name the preset a charge reads as, a hint
only. `flat_fee`: a fixed recurring fee, one unit billed in advance; `seats`: per seat of a
managed quantity, in advance; `usage`: metered usage, in arrears; `usage_levels`: usage sold
in levels a buyer picks, in advance; `one_time`: a fee billed once; `credit_pack`: a pack of
credit, its price buying `grants`.

PreviewPart.description:
A part of a preview that could not be priced, left out of it: `invoice` the invoice the change
issues; `credit_note` the credit note it issues; `next_invoice` the renewal under it;
`subscription_after` the subscription it leaves, which then reads the new charges on the
subscription as it stands, its MRR possibly left out.

PreviousAttributes.description: What the change behind an `*.updated` event replaced, beside its `data`.

custom_properties.description:
The previous value of each custom property the change set, replaced or removed (`null`
where it was unset).

PriceCreditUnit.description:
A usage or overage price expressed in a credit unit: its amounts are credits, each worth
`rate` of the price currency when billed.

rate.description:
What one credit is worth when billed, a decimal string in the price currency's major
unit; not negative.

unit.description: The credit unit the price's amounts are in.

PriceModel.description:
How a price turns the quantity into an amount, by `type`: `per_unit`, every unit at one
price; `graduated`, each unit at the tier it falls in; `volume`, every unit at the tier the
total reaches; `package`, by packages, a started one billed whole; `flat`, one amount;
`dimension_rates`, usage at rates by its dimensions; `rate_card`, usage at a rate card's
dated rates; `levels`, levels a buyer picks; `percentage`, a share of the amount the metric
sums; `dynamic`, that amount as is. `flat` prices a quantity of 1 only; `dimension_rates`,
`rate_card`, `levels`, `percentage` and `dynamic` metered usage only.

PricingCard.description: A plan of the ladder as its card reads.

after_trial.description:
With a trial started today: what is billed each period once it ends, the card's base
price; none when the price is not shown or has no base.

contact_url.description: Where a sales-led card's button leads.

cta_label.description: The label of the card's button.

free.description: Its price is 0 with no other item: nothing to pay.

hide_price.description: The price is not shown: `price` is none and the card reads "Custom pricing".

highlights.description: The lines listed on the card.

option_note.description: Under the price when the plan does not sell the option shown ("Billed monthly").

options.description: The aliases of the options the plan sells in the currency.

plan.description: The plan, without version or option.

price.description: None when the plan is not sold in the currency, or its price is hidden.

trial_days.description: The trial's length in days, when the plan has one.

PricingPage.description:
A product family's pricing page: its self-serve ladder, one card per plan, priced in one
currency and one option.

cards.description: One per plan of the ladder sold in the currency or by contacting sales, in ladder order.

currencies.description: The currencies a visitor switches between: those the ladder is sold in.

currency.description: The currency the page is priced in (ISO 4217).

option.description: The alias of the option shown; none when no plan is sold in the currency.

options.description: The options a visitor switches between.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem: every v2 error answers one, as `application/problem+json`.

code.description: What went wrong; branch on it, not on `title` or `detail`.

detail.description:
What went wrong with this request, in English, for a person to read; it may change at any
time.

errors.description: The fields refused, each at its path; absent when the problem is not a field's.

request_id.description: The id of the request, as in the `Request-Id` header: quote it to support.

status.description: The HTTP status of the response.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem, the same for every problem of its `code`.

type.description:
A URI naming the kind of problem, documented per `code`:
`https://docs.meteroid.com/api/v2/errors/<code>`.

ProblemCode.description:
What went wrong, specific enough to act on. New codes may be added without a new
`Meteroid-Version`: a client reads one it does not know by its HTTP status.

Product.description: What is sold. A product has no price of its own: each charge naming it says how it bills.

archived.description: Off the catalog for new charges; the charges billing it keep billing it.

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; paths and charges take it in place of the id.

color.description: A color token the dashboard shows it in.

description.description: What the product is, in the tenant's words.

entitlements.description: The default rows of its features, canonical.

family.description: The product family it is in.

icon.description: A lucide icon name the dashboard shows it with.

id.description: The product's id, `prd_…`.

name.description: What it is called: a charge billing it takes this name unless it has its own.

ProductEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `Product`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

ProductFamily.description:
A product line the catalog is sorted in, with its pricing page. Products, plans and metrics
are each in one family.

archived.description: Takes no new product, plan or metric; what is in it keeps selling.

code.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; paths take it in place of the id.

id.description: The family's id.

ProductFamilyId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `pf_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ProductFamilyList.description: A page of `ProductFamily` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

ProductFamilyRef.description: A product family named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

ProductId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `prd_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ProductList.description: A page of `Product` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

ProductRef.description: A product named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

PutResource.description: The resource's name and attributes, replaced whole; its archive is unchanged.

attributes.description: From the type's closed lists, without the type's code.

Quantity.description:
How many units a charge bills, by `type`: `fixed`, a count set on the plan; `managed`, a
count each subscription holds and changes (seats); `metered`, the usage a metric measures.

QuantityState.description: A managed quantity the subscription holds (seats).

held.description: The count in force now, as a decimal string.

pending.description: The counts to come, soonest first, each the count once it applies.

QuoteEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `QuoteEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

QuoteEventData.description: A quote accepted, or converted into its subscription.

oneOf.description: Set on `quote.converted`: the subscription it created.

QuoteId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `quo_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

Rate.description: A key's rate in a currency from a day on.

currency.description: None on a credit unit card.

effective_from.description: The day it is in force from.

key.description: A pattern per dimension: a value, a prefix ending in `*`, or `*`.

label.description: A free-text name of the key.

rate.description: None on a scheduled removal of the key.

RateCard.description:
Dated rates of a metric's usage by its dimensions: each usage event is rated by the key its
dimensions' values match. What it rates is fixed once created.

archived.description: Archived: it prices no new charge; the prices it rates keep rating.

at.description: The day `rates` are in force on (a single card only).

credit_unit.description: The credit unit the rates are in, on a `credit_unit` card.

dimensions.description: The event properties a rate's `key` matches, in its order.

on_unmatched.description:
What usage no key matches does: `hold` keeps the invoice waiting until it is rated,
`ignore` leaves it unbilled.

rates.description: The rate of each key and currency in force on `at` (a single card only).

scheduled.description: The changes dated after `at` (a single card only).

unit_size.description: Rates are per this many units (1000000: per 1M tokens).

RateCardChange.description: One change of a rate card, from its activity.

effective_from.description: The day a batch takes effect.

withdrawn.description: Scheduled rates a batch withdrew before their day.

RateCardChangeKind.description:
What a change of a rate card was: `created`, `rates_set` (a batch of rates and removals),
`updated` (renamed, or what unmatched usage does changed), `archived` or `unarchived`.

RateCardChangeList.description: A page of `RateCardChange` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

RateCardId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `rc_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

RateCardList.description: A page of `RateCard` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

RateCardModel.description: Usage rated by a rate card's dated rates.

multiplier.description: Scales every rate of the card (1.2: 20% over the card).

rate_card.description: The rate card, by code or id.

RateChange.description: A key's rate in a currency as a batch changed it, from the batch's day.

currency.description: None on a credit unit card.

from.description: The rate the day before; none when the key had none.

key.description: A pattern per dimension, in the card's order.

to.description: None: the key is removed from the day.

RateInput.description: A key's rate to set from the batch's day.

currency.description: Required on a money card, left out on a credit unit card.

key.description: A pattern per dimension, in the card's order: a value, a prefix ending in `*`, or `*`.

label.description: A free-text name of the key.

rate.description:
Per `unit_size` units, a decimal string: in the currency's major unit on a money card, in
credit units on a credit unit card.

RateRemoval.description:
A key to remove from the batch's day: its usage is then rated by the other keys it matches,
or is unmatched. Its rates scheduled after that day are withdrawn.

currency.description: The currency it is removed in, on a money card; left out on a credit unit card.

key.description: The key as its rates were set.

RatesSet.description: What a batch of rates did, and the card as of its day.

rate_card.description: The card as of the batch's day.

replaced.description: Scheduled rates the batch replaced or withdrew.

unchanged.description: Rates already in force, or already there: left as they were.

RecordPayment.description: A payment received outside Meteroid (a bank transfer, a check).

amount.description: In minor units of the invoice's currency, at most what is due.

paid_at.description: When it was received, at most a day ahead; now when left out.

Recurrence.description: Whether a charge bills each period (`recurring`) or once, on the first invoice (`one_time`).

RecurringAmount.description: The recurring fees billed on one cadence.

amount.description: In minor units of the currency.

ReportUsage.description:
A count your app reports for a limit it counts: `set` the count, or `add` to it (negative to
remove), for the customer or for one resource.

at.description: When the count was true; the time received by default.

resource.description:
The resource counted, stored or not: `{"id": …}`, or `{"type": …, "key": …}`. Left out:
the customer as a whole.

Reset.description: When the usage counted against a limit starts again from zero.

archived.description: An archived resource still resolves in checks.

attributes.description: `{"<attribute>": "<value>"}`, without the type's code; they win over asserted ones.

key.description: The value of the type's keys (`s1`).

ResourceId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `res_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ResourceList.description: A page of `Resource` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

ResourceName.description:
A customer's resource: `{"id": "res_…"}` for a stored one, or its type and key value,
`{"type": "site", "key": "s1"}`, which a check, a snapshot or a usage report may name without
the resource being stored. Send `id`, or `type` and `key`.

id.description: A stored resource's id.

type.description: With `key`: the resource type's code, or its id.

ResourceRef.description:
A customer's stored resource named by another resource: its human key is its type's code and
its key value.

key.description: The value of the type's key.

attributes.description: Each attribute with its closed list of values.

code.description: Immutable: conditions name attributes as `<code>.<attribute>`, paths as `<code>=<key>`.

keys.description: The identifying keys, the canonical one first, then its aliases.

property.description: The event property holding the resource's key; none: the type's keys.

resource_type.description: The resource type, by code (id or code on input).

ResourceTypeId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `rty_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ResourceTypeList.description: A tenant has few types: the list is not paged.

ResourceTypeRef.description: A resource type named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

id.description: Its id.

ReversePayment.description: A payment recorded by hand, clawed back.

reason.description: A free-text reason, kept as the payment's `reversal_reason`.

reversed_at.description: When it was clawed back, at most a day ahead; now when left out.

Rollover.description: Included credit left at expiry, carried once into a new grant.

max_amount.description:
Cap per rolled grant, positive, in the grant's currency or credit unit; none carries all
that is left.

Rounding.description:
How a period's usage is rounded once divided by `factor`: `up`, `down`, `nearest` (halves
away from zero), `nearest_half` (to the nearest 0.5), `nearest_decile` (to the nearest 0.1),
or `none` (kept as divided).

Schedule.description: The changes of a subscription waiting for their date.

ScheduledChange.description: A change waiting for its date.

amendment.description: What an amendment adds and removes.

id.description: The scheduled change's id, as a change made answers it in `scheduled_change`.

initiated_by_customer.description: Asked by the customer, from the portal, rather than by the tenant.

plan.description: The plan a plan change moves to.

ScheduledChangeType.description:
What a scheduled change does: `plan_change` moves the subscription to another plan, option
or version; `cancellation` ends it; `amendment` adds or removes charges and add-ons.

ScheduledEventId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `sev_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

SeatActivation.description:
When the seats an increase adds are in force: `immediate` at once, their prorated invoice
issued beside them as the subscription's invoicing says; `on_payment` once the invoice billing
them is paid, the change `pending_payment` until then (an increase billing nothing applies at
once).

groupId.description: The group (account) the event is for: the customer's alias by default.

SegmentTrackEvent.description: A Segment `track` event; any other field Segment sends is ignored.

context.description: Segment's context: only its `groupId` is read.

event.description: The event's name, as written in Segment: the event code metrics read.

groupId.description: A group id mapped to the top level, read before `context.groupId`.

messageId.description: Segment's id of the message: the event's `event_id`, so Segment's retries count once.

properties.description:
Nested objects are flattened to dotted keys (`plan.tier`), arrays kept as JSON text, nulls
dropped.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339; the time it is received when left out.

userId.description: The user: the customer's alias with `customer=user`.

SetRates.description:
Rates set and keys removed together, all from one day (today when left out). Keys not
listed keep their rates; a repeated batch changes nothing.

effective_from.description:
The day the whole batch takes effect; today when left out. Only a key's first rate in a
currency may start on a past day.

ShippingAddress.description: Where goods are shipped: the billing address, or another.

address.description: Where goods are shipped, when not to the billing address.

same_as_billing.description: Goods are shipped to the billing address; `address` is then not read. `false` by default.

SlidingWindowReset.description: The usage of the last `interval` `unit`s, up to now. Sends no alerts.

SnapshotResource.description: The resource a snapshot is for.

id.description: A stored resource's id; absent for one named ad hoc.

SubLine.description: A part of a line: a tier of a seat or usage price, a package, a rate of one dimension value.

amount.description: In minor units, before discounts and tax.

dimensions.description: The dimension values a rate by dimension priced.

id.description: Its id within its line: a credit note credits it by it (`lines[].sub_lines[].id`).

quantity.description: The units it prices, as a decimal string.

raw_usage.description: A package price's usage before it was rounded up to whole packages.

tier.description: The tier it prices, on a tiered or volume price.

first_unit.description: The unit the tier starts at.

flat_cap.description: The most the tier bills, its flat fee included, in the currency's major unit.

flat_fee.description: The tier's flat fee, billed once the quantity reaches it, in the currency's major unit.

last_unit.description: Absent for the last tier, which has no upper end.

mode.description: How the price reads its tiers.

Subscription.description:
A subscription. Lists carry what the subscription itself holds; `quantities`, `levels`,
`charges`, `add_ons`, `coupons`, `schedule`, `cancellation` and `minimum` are read on a single
one.

billing_day_anchor.description:
The day of the month its periods start on, 1 to 31 (a shorter month starts its period on
its last day).

cancellation.description: The cancellation waiting for its date; absent when none is scheduled.

charges.description: The charges it bills: its plan's, its add-ons' and those added to it.

currency.description: What it is billed in (ISO 4217).

current_period.description: The billing period it is in.

custom_properties.description: Values of the tenant's subscription properties, by key.

dates.description: Its start, end, billing start, activation and ending.

entitlement_overrides.description: Its own entitlement rows, the subscription tier (`set` only); read on a single one.

external_id.description: The integrator's own id, unique per tenant; paths take it in place of the id.

grants.description:
What the offers applied to it give: each grant with its window, where it came from and
what it wrote; absent when it has none.

id.description: The subscription's id, `sub_…`.

levels.description:
The level of each usage-levels charge, by product code, as the usage it includes:
`{"api": "10000"}`.

metrics_not_attributed.description:
With `metric_not_attributed`: the codes of the metrics it prices that are not attributed
to its resource's type, so it bills none of their usage.

minimum.description: The floor on what it is billed each period; absent when it has none.

plan.description: The plan, with the version and option it is on.

quantities.description: The managed quantities it holds (seats), by code.

resource.description:
The stored resource it is for (a workspace, a project), fixed once active: it bills the
metrics attributed to that resource's type, for the events carrying its key value. None:
the whole customer.

schedule.description: The changes waiting for their date, soonest first.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

tax_inclusive.description: Its prices are quoted tax included (its plan version's, when it was created).

trial.description: Its trial; absent when it has none.

updated_at.description: When it, or anything read of it, last changed.

SubscriptionAddOnId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `sub_add_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

add_on.description: The add-on of a charge from an add-on.

SubscriptionCharge.description:
A charge the subscription bills, as a plan's charge reads: its one price is the one this
subscription is billed (`*`, in its currency and cadence).

SubscriptionCredit.description: Credit that only one subscription can use.

credit_on_account.description: Its credit on account, in minor units of the wallet.

subscription.description: The subscription it pays the charges of.

SubscriptionEntitlement.description: A feature the subscription includes, at the level it includes it.

applies_per.description: The resource type the feature applies per; none: the customer.

product.description: The product the feature belongs to; none for a feature of the whole catalog.

resource.description: With `level: resource_type`: the resource the subscription is for.

unit.description: What a number or a limit counts.

used.description:
A limit's usage at the level: the count your app reported, or the metric's events over
`window`; absent when it could not be read.

value.description: The deciding subscription's value at the level.

SubscriptionEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `Subscription`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

previous_attributes.description: On `customer.updated` and `subscription.updated`: what the change replaced. Absent when it replaced none of the attributes listed there.

SubscriptionGrant.description:
A grant of an offer applied to the subscription: what it gives, its window there, where it
came from and what it wrote.

id.description: The offer's grant.

SubscriptionGrantDates.description: A grant's window on the subscription.

until.description: Exclusive; absent when it lasts as long as the subscription or counts invoices.

SubscriptionGrantRef.description:
What the grant wrote on the subscription: the coupon redemption a discount or credit bills
through, the credit grant funded, the entitlement row, the add-on given.

SubscriptionGrantSource.description: Where a subscription's grant came from: the offer applied, and the coupon whose code gave it.

SubscriptionGrantSourceType.description:
How an offer came to the subscription: `plan` its plan's start offer; `offer` a catalog offer
named by the tenant or a quote; `coupon` a coupon's code; `retention` the cancel flow; `api`
a catalog offer named through the API.

SubscriptionId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `sub_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

SubscriptionList.description: A page of `Subscription` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

SubscriptionOfferInput.description:
What a new subscription is given beside its plan: the plan's start offer, none, or a catalog
offer. Its trial is the offer's unless `trial` asks another.

SubscriptionRef.description: A subscription named by another resource.

external_id.description: The integrator's own id of the subscription; paths take it in place of the id.

id.description: The subscription's id.

SubscriptionStatus.description:
Where the subscription is in its life: `pending_activation` before its start, or waiting for
its checkout or a manual activation; `trial_active` in its trial; `active` billing;
`trial_expired` a free trial ended without the checkout that starts billing; `cancelled`
ended by a cancellation; `aborted` cancelled before it was ever active; `completed` ended on
its end date.

SubscriptionTrialInput.description:
The trial a new subscription starts with: the plan's, none, an offer, or one of its own
terms. A trial is free.

TaxStatus.description:
How the customer's invoices are taxed: normally, not at all (with an `exemption_reason`), or
with the tax due by the customer (reverse charge). `taxable`: taxed at the rates that apply
(the default); `exempt`: no tax, the `exemption_reason` printed; `reverse_charge`: no tax
charged, the customer accounts for it.

TenantId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `ten_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

TextValue.description: A text, or one of a select's options.

Tier.description: A tier of a graduated or volume price: it runs from `first_unit` up to the next tier's.

first_unit.description: The first unit the tier prices; the first tier starts at 0, the next ones strictly above.

flat_cap.description: The most the tier bills: its units' amount and `flat_fee` together, capped.

flat_fee.description: A fee for reaching the tier, added to its units' amount.

unit_price.description: Per unit in the tier, a decimal string in the currency's major unit.

TierMode.description:
How a tiered price reads its tiers: `graduated`, each unit at the price of the tier it falls
in; `volume`, every unit at the price of the tier the whole quantity falls in.

TimelineEffect.description: A subscription's timeline written again over a change.

invoices_before.description: The invoices ahead without the change, fixed fees before tax and credits.

details.description: The inactive terms, or why it was dropped.

Timing.description:
When a charge bills. Left out of a request, a metered charge bills recurring in arrears
(in advance when priced in levels), any other recurring in advance.

billing.description:
At the start of the period, or at its end. A one-time charge, seats and usage levels
bill in advance; other usage in arrears.

TopUp.description: Where a top-up stands; `wallet.funded` reports its credit granted.

amount.description: Credit bought, in minor units of `currency`, or of `credit_unit` when set.

charged_amount.description: Charged, tax included, in minor units of `currency`; absent until a charge is made.

checkout_url.description: Where the customer pays, while it waits for them.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit bought; absent for currency credit.

currency.description: The money it is paid in.

payment_transaction.description: The payment charged; absent until a charge is made.

TopUpCollection.description:
How a top-up is paid: `charge` a saved payment method now, or `send_invoice` and grant the
credit once it is paid.

TopUpStatus.description:
Where a top-up stands: `succeeded` (paid, the credit granted), `pending` (the charge is
settling), `requires_customer_action` (the customer authenticates or pays at `checkout_url`)
or `awaiting_payment` (the invoice is issued; the credit is granted once it is paid).

plan.description: The plan switched to, at its version, for `switch`.

type.description: Convert, decide manually, cancel or switch plan.

TrialAtEndInput.description: What a trial's end does, as written: `switch` names its plan.

plan.description: For `switch`: the plan, by code or id.

type.description: Convert, decide manually, cancel or switch plan.

version.description: For `switch`: a published version's number; the active one when left out.

TrialAtEndType.description:
What a trial's end does: `convert` the subscription goes on, billed from then; `manual`
nothing is billed and the trial's access goes on until it is converted (`…/trial/end`),
extended or cancelled; `cancel` the subscription ends with it; `switch` it moves to `plan`.

TrialCard.description:
Whether sign-up, checkout and the pricing page ask for a card to start the trial. A
subscription's activation decides for itself.

TrialEligibility.description:
Who is given the trial once: per `offer`, per `plan`, per `product_family`, or `none` (every
subscription).

TrialEndPreview.description: What ending a trial today would do, nothing written.

documents.description:
What it would issue today: the opening invoice of a conversion, or what a switch of plan
issues.

effective_date.description: The day it would end: today.

incomplete.description: True when a part of the preview could not be priced and is left out (`missing` names it).

outcome.description: How it would end: its end action applied today (a manual one converts).

subscription_after.description: The subscription as it would read once its trial ended.

TrialEndedEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `TrialEndedEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

TrialEndedEventData.description:
A subscription's trial ended: how (`outcome`). Sent again when an outcome awaiting a payment
or a decision resolves.

TrialEndingEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `TrialEndingEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

TrialEndingEventData.description:
A subscription's trial ends within 7 days, once per trial end (at its start when it is
shorter).

billing_starts_on.description:
When billing starts, the trial converting at its end; absent when its end cancels the
subscription or waits for a decision.

oneOf.description: What the trial's end is estimated to charge first, when it converts.

free.description: Always `true`: a trial is free. Kept for one release.

has_payment_method.description: Whether the subscription has a payment method it is charged or invoiced with.

trial_end.description: The trial's end, exclusive; `ends_on`, kept for one release.

TrialListParam.description: The trials a list narrows to.

TrialOfThePlan.description:
The plan's trial, asked: refused when the customer already had it. Left out, the plan's
trial is given unless the customer already had it.

TrialOfferId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `ofr_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

TrialOfferSummary.description: A trial offer, as a subscription or a plan names it.

code.description: Its code, when it has one.

id.description: The offer's id.

TrialState.description:
The subscription's trial, the free period before it is billed, as recorded at its start;
absent when it has none. Lists carry its `days`; the rest is read on a single subscription.

billing_starts_on.description: The day billing starts when the subscription converts: its end.

days.description: Its length in days, from its start.

ends_on.description: Exclusive: the day after its last.

features_of.description: The plan whose features it gives over the subscription's own; none: its own.

first_charge_estimate.description: What its end is estimated to charge first, while it runs and converts.

has_payment_method.description: Whether the subscription has a payment method it is charged or invoiced with.

offer.description: The trial offer it came from.

outcome.description: How it ended; absent while it runs.

without_card.description:
What a converting end does if the subscription is charged automatically and has no
payment method then.

TrialWithoutCard.description:
What a converting trial's end does if the subscription is charged automatically and has no
payment method then. A subscription paid by invoice converts and is invoiced on its terms.

plan.description: The plan switched to, at its version, for `switch`.

type.description: Await the payment, cancel or switch plan.

TrialWithoutCardInput.description:
What a converting trial's end does if the subscription is charged automatically and has no
payment method then, as written: `switch` names its plan.

plan.description: For `switch`: the plan, by code or id.

type.description: Await the payment, cancel or switch plan.

version.description: For `switch`: a published version's number; the active one when left out.

TrialWithoutCardType.description:
What a converting trial's end does if the subscription is charged automatically and has no
payment method then: `await_payment` its opening invoice is issued and it turns active once
paid; `cancel` it ends with the trial, nothing invoiced; `switch` it moves to `plan`.

UnattributedMetricUsage.description: A stretch of a metric's usage no subscription bills.

quantity.description: The usage no subscription bills, aggregated as the metric aggregates.

subscriptions.description:
The subscriptions for a resource pricing the metric then, none of whose resources the
usage is attributed to.

UnattributedUsage.description: A customer's usage over `[from, to)` that no subscription bills.

metrics.description: The stretches of usage no subscription bills, by metric.

UnitConversion.description: Usage divided by `factor` (tokens priced per 1M: 1000000), then each period's total rounded.

factor.description: What usage is divided by, 1 or more.

rounding.description: How each period's divided total is rounded.

UnitPrice.description: The price this customer agreed for one credit of a unit, in major units of `currency`.

currency.description: The customer's currency (ISO 4217).

price.description: The price of one credit, a decimal string.

Unmatched.description:
What happens to usage no rate matches: `hold` (the default), the invoice waits until the
usage is rated; `ignore`, the usage is left unbilled.

UpcomingCredit.description: One kind of credit the invoice is expected to draw.

amount.description: In minor units of `currency`.

before_tax.description: Taken off the charges before tax (promotional credit); otherwise paid on the taxed total.

label.description: "Included with Scale", "Purchased credit", "Free credit" or "Account balance".

subscription.description: The subscription the credit belongs to; absent when it pays any of the customer's.

UpcomingInvoice.description:
A subscription's next invoice as it would be issued today: its fixed charges for the next
period, the usage of the current one so far, the changes scheduled by its date, and the credit
it would draw once every invoice billed before it drew its own. Amounts in minor units.

amount_due.description: What is left to pay once credit applies.

applied_credits.description: Credit drawn on the taxed total.

billed_first.description: The pending invoices billed first that draw on the same credit.

change.description: What it settles besides a renewal; absent for a plain renewal.

credit_estimate_shared.description: The credit is shared with other pending invoices, so the amounts after it are estimates.

credits.description: The credit drawn, by kind, in draw order.

discount.description: What discounts and coupons take off.

finalized_on.description: When it is finalized (and charged, when charged automatically): after the grace period.

invoice_date.description:
The date it is issued for: the period's end, or the end date of a final invoice
(`change: ends`), which can fall before `period_end`.

invoiced.description: False when nothing will be invoiced: a subscription that never activated ends without one.

new_plan.description: The plan a scheduled plan change moves to.

plan.description: The plan the subscription is on now.

subtotal.description: The lines' total before discounts, credit and tax.

UpcomingInvoiceChange.description:
What the next invoice settles besides renewing the period: `ends`, the subscription's final
invoice (cancelled, or reaching its end date); `plan_change`, a scheduled plan change takes
effect on its date; `amendment`, a scheduled amendment does.

UpdateAddOn.description: A merge patch. `prices` replaces every price of the charge; how it bills never changes.

entitlements.description:
Replaces its rows: one sent the same keeps its id and history, one changed is succeeded,
one left out is revoked; `[]` revokes them all.

max_instances.description: How many a subscription may hold, 1 or more; `null`: no limit.

name.description: 1 to 255 characters; it cannot be cleared.

prices.description:
Replaces every price of the charge: one per currency and cadence, each `*`. Prices
billing the add-on another way than it bills are refused (`not_expressible`).

self_serviceable.description: Customers may add it themselves (portal, checkout).

UpdateCoupon.description:
A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it. The code, the redemption
limit and `reusable` never change; `discount` replaces the discount whole (it cannot switch
between promotional credit and an invoice discount).

UpdateCreditNote.description: A JSON merge patch of a credit note: its custom properties.

custom_properties.description:
Merged into the note's: a key sent `null` is removed. Validated against the tenant's credit
note custom property definitions.

UpdateCreditUnit.description:
A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it. In `prices`, a currency set
replaces its price (the previous one is kept for what pinned it) and `null` stops selling the
unit in that currency; currencies left out keep theirs.

prices.description: The prices to set, by currency; `null` archives a currency's price.

product.description: The product its sales are booked under, by code or id; `null`: the unit is no longer sold.

UpdateCustomer.description:
A JSON merge patch of a customer (RFC 7396): a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it,
an object (an address, `tax`, `invoicing`, `custom_properties`) is merged field by field, a
list is replaced. Every field of the customer as written may be sent.

alias.description: The integrator's own id, unique per tenant; `null` removes it.

billing_address.description: Merged part by part; `null` removes the address.

currency.description: One of the tenant's currencies (ISO 4217).

custom_properties.description: Merged by key: `null` removes a property.

invoicing.description: Merged field by field; `emails` and `preferred_locales` are replaced.

shipping_address.description: Merged field by field; `null` removes it.

tax.description: Merged field by field; `custom_rates` is replaced.

UpdateEntitlementOverride.description:
A merge patch of an override: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it (except
`value` and `effect`, which cannot be cleared). The feature, the level and the resource are
fixed: revoke the row and create another to change them.

UpdateFeature.description: A merge patch of the feature as written. The code never changes.

applies_per.description: `null`: the customer. Refused while the feature has rows, or counts reported by your app.

defaults.description: Replaces the default rows; `[]` removes them.

UpdateFeatureType.description: A merge patch of the type's fields that change; the others, sent, must read as they are.

UpdateInvoice.description:
A JSON merge patch of an invoice: its custom properties at any status; its lines, memo,
purchase order and due date while it is a draft.

custom_properties.description:
Merged into the invoice's: a key sent `null` is removed. Validated against the tenant's
invoice custom property definitions.

due_date.description: A draft's; `null`: its net terms from the day it is issued.

lines.description:
A draft's lines, all of them (a list replaces): a line kept is named by its `id`, a line
left out is removed, a line without an `id` is added. The draft then finalizes from these
lines as written, no longer priced again from the usage.

UpdateManagedQuantity.description: A merge patch; the code never changes.

on_decrease.description: Applies to the changes made from then on.

on_increase.description: Applies to the changes made from then on.

UpdateMetric.description: A merge patch. The code, event code, aggregation, group, family and product never change.

attributed_to.description:
Applies to the periods not yet finalized: their draft invoices are recomputed. Fixed
once a subscription for a resource has invoiced the metric, refused while one is live.

breakdown_by.description:
The event property each invoice line is broken down by; `null` removes it. Refused
(`403`) when usage breakdowns are not in the organization's plan.

unit_conversion.description: `null` removes it: usage is then priced as aggregated.

unit_singular.description: Sent with `unit_plural`; both `null` remove the unit.

UpdatePlan.description:
A merge patch of the live fields; versions are written through the draft, the status by
`…/archive` and `…/unarchive`.

listing.description: Merged field by field into the plan's listing.

name.description: 1 to 255 characters; it cannot be cleared.

sold_for.description:
The resource type its subscriptions are for, by code or id; `null`: the customer. A plan
sold for a type carries no rows across all resources.

trial.description: Its trial, on every version at once: its terms, or a trial offer; `null` removes it.

UpdateProduct.description: A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it.

entitlements.description:
The default rows of its features, replaced together: each names one of its features, and
one of its features left out loses its defaults. Features are made with their product
(`POST /features`).

icon.description: A lucide icon name the dashboard ships (`box`, `cpu`, `users`…).

name.description: 1 to 255 characters; it cannot be cleared.

UpdateRateCard.description: A merge patch of what a card may change: its name and what unmatched usage does.

on_unmatched.description: What usage no key matches does from then on.

UpdateResourceType.description: A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged; the lists replace. None can be cleared.

attributes.description: Removing a value a resource or a row's condition uses is refused, the uses listed.

keys.description:
The same clash check as on create; refused while a subscription for one of the type's
resources prices a metric.

UpdateSubscription.description: A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it.

custom_properties.description:
Merged into the subscription's, validated against the tenant's custom property
definitions.

end_date.description:
The day it stops renewing and completes; `null`: it renews until cancelled. Only what is
not billed yet moves: a date after today that cuts no period already billed (a date inside
one is a cancellation on that date: `POST …/cancel`). Refused while a cancellation is
scheduled, or a change on or after the date.

entitlement_overrides.description:
The subscription's own entitlement rows, written whole (`set` only): a row read back the
same keeps its id and history, one changed gets a successor, one left out is revoked.
`[]` revokes them all.

external_id.description: The integrator's own id, unique per tenant; `null` clears it.

invoicing.description: Its invoicing terms from now on, merged field by field.

resource.description:
A stored resource of the customer to subscribe for, `{"id": …}` or
`{"type": …, "key": …}`; `null`: the whole customer. Only before the subscription is active.

UpdateWallet.description:
A merge patch of a wallet's settings: a field left out is unchanged. `null` clears the
thresholds, turns automatic top-up off (removing its terms) and returns the customer to the
unit's list price; an `auto_top_up` object replaces the terms whole.

auto_top_up.description: The terms of its automatic top-up, replaced whole; `null` turns it off and removes them.

unit_price.description: Credit unit wallets: a decimal string, in major units of the customer's currency.

usage_at_zero.description: What the customer's usage does once the credit runs out.

UpdateWebhookEndpoint.description:
A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it; `event_types` and `headers`
replace the lists. Enabling an endpoint again resets its failure count.

api_version.description:
Pins its payloads to another published version (`2026-12-15` for v2's), from its next
event on; it cannot be removed.

disabled.description:
`true` disables it (`disabled_reason: manual`); `false` enables it again and resets its
failure count.

event_types.description: Replaces the list; empty receives every event type but the beta ones.

headers.description: Replaces the list; a sensitive header sent without a value keeps the one it has.

url.description: Another HTTPS URL, checked as on create.

UsageAmount.description: An amount in minor units of its currency, or of its credit unit for usage priced in credit.

amount.description: In minor units of `currency`, or of `credit_unit`.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit; what credit leaves uncovered is invoiced in money, not counted here.

currency.description: ISO 4217, for an amount in money; absent beside `credit_unit`.

UsageCosts.description:
A metric's usage and cost per bucket over `[from, to)`, cut at UTC boundaries, within the
billing periods pricing it.

UsageEstimate.description: What an event would add to the subscription's next invoice, were it ingested now.

complete.description: False when a metric's fee could not be estimated: `totals` then leaves it out.

computed_at.description: When the usage it adds to was read.

metrics.description:
The metrics that would bill it; empty when none would: filtered out, outside the
subscription's scope, or nothing invoiced (a subscription cancelled or paused). Empty means
"not billed", not "free".

timestamp.description: The time the event is priced at.

totals.description: The metrics' fees added up, per currency or credit unit.

UsageEvent.description: A usage event a metric read, as metering keeps it.

cost.description:
Per-unit prices and rates by dimension only: absent for prices depending on the whole
period's usage, and for a metric whose unit conversion rounds.

id.description: The id the event was ingested with.

properties.description: Its properties, each value as text.

quantity.description:
The billed units it adds; absent when the aggregation cannot be split per event, or the
event does not count.

timestamp.description: When it happened: the `timestamp` it was ingested with.

UsageEventList.description: A page of `UsageEvent` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

UsageGroup.description: The usage of one group of a metric's dimensions.

dimensions.description: The value of each dimension the metric groups by, by dimension.

quantity.description: The group's usage, aggregated as the metric aggregates.

computed_at.description:
Beta, on a subscription's current period only: when `costs` and `totals` were computed;
the reading is shared for up to 30 seconds.

projected_totals.description: Beta: the metrics' projected costs added up; absent unless every metric has one.

totals.description: Beta: the metrics' costs added up, per currency or credit unit.

UsageSource.description:
Where the usage came from: `read` when checking, or `live`: kept up to date as usage events
arrive (Enterprise edition).

UsageWindow.description: The period a limit counted from events counts usage over.

end.description: Exclusive: the next reset. Absent for a limit that never resets.

ValueFeature.description: A value: a number, a text, one of a select's options, or any JSON.

higher_is_better.description: A number's direction: a higher one is the better grant (true by default).

options.description: A select's options, distinct; one a row still holds cannot be removed.

ordered.description: A select's options rank its grants, the last the best (false by default).

VatNumberStatus.description:
The VIES check of the VAT number: `pending` (not checked yet), `valid`, `invalid`, or
`unavailable` (VIES could not answer).

add_on.description: The add-on, by code (id or code on input).

max_instances.description: How many of it a subscription may hold; overrides the add-on's own.

self_serviceable.description: Customers may add it themselves (portal, checkout); overrides the add-on's own.

VersionStatus.description:
Where a version is in its life: `draft`, being written and not sold yet; `active`, the one
new subscriptions get; `superseded`, published then replaced by a later version, its
subscriptions keeping it.

VolumeModel.description: Every unit priced by the tier the total reaches.

tiers.description: 1 to 100 tiers, the first starting at unit 0, ascending.

Wallet.description:
A customer's credit in one currency or credit unit. The customer's own currency is always
listed, even empty.

auto_top_up.description: Its automatic top-up; absent when none is set.

balance.description:
`credit_on_account` less the part of `unbilled_usage` credit will pay; never negative.
Absent until the customer's usage was priced once.

credit_on_account.description:
Credit granted, in effect, not applied to an invoice nor expired; usage not invoiced yet is
not deducted (see `balance`).

credit_unit.description: The credit unit; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

currency.description: Absent for a credit unit wallet.

low_balance_thresholds.description: Balances sending `wallet.balance_low` once crossed downward; ascending, at most 5.

pauses_at_zero.description: Usage stops once the credit is used up, for one active subscription at least.

subscription_credit.description: The part of `credit_on_account` only one subscription can use, per subscription.

unbilled_usage.description: Usage priced but not invoiced yet, tax included.

unit_price.description: A credit unit wallet: the customer's agreed price per credit; the list price when absent.

upcoming_credit.description: Credit granted that takes effect later.

usage_at_zero.description: What the customer's usage does once the credit runs out, as set for this customer.

usage_only_credit.description: The part of `credit_on_account` that pays only usage charges.

WalletCreditRecoveredEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `WalletCreditRecoveredEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

WalletCreditRecoveredEventData.description: Credit left unrecovered was taken back since. Amounts in minor units of the wallet.

WalletCreditUnrecoveredEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `WalletCreditUnrecoveredEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

WalletCreditUnrecoveredEventData.description:
Credit bought was spent when its money came back (a reversed payment, a refund): part of it
could not be taken back. Amounts in minor units of the wallet.

credit_unrecovered_total.description: What stays unrecovered of this money, every notice of it counted.

WalletDebitedEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `WalletDebitedEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

WalletDebitedEventData.description: Credit leaving a wallet: applied to an invoice, taken back by a credit note, or removed by hand.

credit_grant.description: The grant the credit left, as `GET /customers/{id}/credit-grants/{grant_id}` reads it.

reason.description: Why the credit left, as it was recorded.

wallet.description: The wallet after the movement, as `GET /customers/{id}/wallets/{wallet}` reads it.

WalletFundedEvent.description: An event's payload in API v2's shape, sent to an endpoint whose `api_version` is `2026-12-15` or later; `data` is a `WalletFundedEventData`.

id.description: The event's id, also its `webhook-id` header: the same on every retry and to every endpoint.

api_version.description: The version the payload is rendered at: the endpoint's `api_version` when the event was processed.

WalletFundedEventData.description:
Credit added to a wallet: a purchase, a top-up, a plan's credit, a coupon, a credit note, a
grant by hand, or what a voided invoice gave back.

credit_grant.description: The grant credited, as `GET /customers/{id}/credit-grants/{grant_id}` reads it.

source.description:
Why the credit came in: the grant's source, or what gave a draw back (`credit_note`;
`adjustment` for a voided invoice, or a usage settlement returning what it drew).

wallet.description: The wallet after the movement, as `GET /customers/{id}/wallets/{wallet}` reads it.

WalletList.description: Every wallet of the customer, one per currency or credit unit: a list never paged.

data.description: The wallets, the customer's own currency first.

WebhookDelivery.description: One event queued for one endpoint.

attempts.description: Attempts made so far, the resends' included.

completed_at.description: When it ended: succeeded, failed or cancelled.

endpoint.description: The endpoint it is sent to.

id.description: The delivery's id, `whd_…`: the one `POST /webhooks/deliveries/{id}/resend` takes.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt failed, when it did.

last_response_status.description: The HTTP status of the last answer.

manual.description: Made by a resend or a test event.

next_attempt_at.description: When the next attempt is due; absent once the delivery ended.

status.description: Where it is in its retry cycle.

WebhookDeliveryId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `whd_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

WebhookDeliveryList.description: A page of `WebhookDelivery` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

WebhookEndpoint.description: Where Meteroid POSTs the signed payloads of the events it subscribes to.

api_version.description:
The API version its payloads are rendered at: the `Meteroid-Version` it was created at,
or the one a patch set. From `2026-12-15` on, v2's envelopes, whose `data` reads as the
resource's v2 GET; before it, v1's payloads. Absent on an endpoint created through v1 (or
the dashboard before it pinned versions), which keeps v1's payloads. A pinned endpoint
never changes shape: only a patch moves it.

archived_at.description: Set by `POST …/archive`, read only in its answer: an archived endpoint is no longer read.

consecutive_failures.description: Failures since the last success; 0 again on any 2xx.

description.description: What the endpoint is for, as the tenant wrote it.

disabled.description: A disabled endpoint receives nothing: its deliveries are cancelled.

disabled_reason.description: Why it is disabled; absent while it is enabled.

event_types.description:
The event types it receives, as a payload's `type` names them (`invoice.paid`). Empty:
every event type but the beta ones, sent only to endpoints naming them.

headers.description: The headers sent with every delivery, beside the signature's.

id.description: The endpoint's id, `whe_…`.

last_failure_at.description: When a delivery to it last failed.

last_success_at.description: When it last answered a delivery with a 2xx.

max_in_flight.description: Deliveries in flight at once, at most; set from the tenant's environment.

needs_setup.description: A sensitive header waits for its value: the endpoint cannot be enabled before.

paused_until.description:
Unreachable several times in a row: nothing is sent before then, then one delivery at a
time until it answers.

rate_limit_per_sec.description: Deliveries started per second, at most.

updated_at.description: When it last changed; absent if it never did.

url.description: The HTTPS URL deliveries are POSTed to.

WebhookEndpointId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `whe_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

WebhookEndpointList.description: A page of `WebhookEndpoint` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

WebhookHeader.description:
A header sent with every delivery. A sensitive one never reads its value back: `set` says
whether it has one.

sensitive.description: Write-only: its value is stored encrypted and never read back.

set.description:
Whether it has a value. A sensitive header without one keeps the endpoint from being
enabled (`needs_setup`).

value.description: Its value; absent on a sensitive header.

WebhookHeaderInput.description:
A header to send with every delivery. A sensitive one is write-only; in a patch, one sent
without a value keeps the value it has.

name.description:
The header's name, unique ignoring case. Meteroid sets `webhook-*`, `svix-*`,
`proxy-*`, `content-type`, `user-agent` and the connection's headers (`host`,
`content-length`…): those are refused.

sensitive.description: Write-only: its value is stored encrypted and never read back.

value.description:
Its value, without a line break. Required, but on a sensitive header of a patch, where
leaving it out keeps the value it has.

WebhookSecret.description: The secret deliveries are signed with.

secret.description:
`whsec_` followed by the base64 (standard alphabet) of 24 random bytes. The HMAC-SHA256
key is those bytes, the part after `whsec_` decoded; a Standard Webhooks library takes
the whole string. A delivery's `webhook-signature` is `v1,` and the base64 of the HMAC of
`<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<body>`; after a rotation it holds one signature per
secret still signing, separated by spaces (the Webhooks tag says how to verify one).
Keep it secret: anyone holding it can sign a delivery.

When.description:
When a change takes effect. Which a change accepts is checked in one place (`when.rs`): a plan
change, an amendment or a level move take effect now or at the period's end, a downgrade of
plan or level at the period's end only; a cancellation also on a date.

date.description: The day it takes effect, with `type: date` only (required then).

WhenType.description:
When a change takes effect: `immediate` now, prorated; `period_end` at the end of the current
period; `date` on `date` (cancellations only).

BadRequest.description: The request could not be read: a malformed body or parameter, or an unsupported `Meteroid-Version`.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, unknown or revoked.

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer`: the API key is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

TooManyRequests.description:
Too many requests: retry later, with the same `Idempotency-Key` for a POST.

Limits are per tenant environment, every API key of the tenant sharing them, each a token bucket refilled continuously over its window. At their defaults (a self-hosted instance sets its own, `RATE_LIMIT_REST_*`), production first, then any other environment:

- Requests: 100 and 25 a second, every route but the event routes; `RateLimit-Policy` names the bucket `rest:api` (`rest:non_prod:api`).
- Requests to the event routes (`/api/v2/events/…`): 500 and 125 a second, bucket `rest:metering` (`rest:non_prod:metering`).
- Events ingested: 5,000 and 1,250 a second, each `POST /events/ingest` counting the events it holds, unless the organization's plan sets its own.
- Usage reads (`/usage/summary`, and `…/usage…` under a customer or a subscription): 600 and 120 a minute, unless the organization's plan sets its own.
- Event corrections (`/events/{event_id}/void` and `…/amend`, Enterprise edition): 600 and 120 changes a minute.

The first two count requests: their `429` carries `Retry-After` and the `RateLimit` headers, which every response they counted carries too. The others are counted within the request, after it passed the first: their `429 rate_limited` carries `Retry-After` and says the same wait in `detail` (`Retry after <n> seconds`), without the `RateLimit` headers.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Sent when the request rate refused the request; a limit counted within a request (events per second, usage cost reads, event corrections) says its wait in `detail`.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the bucket holds when full.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the bucket: `0` on a refusal.

RateLimit-Reset.description: The Unix time, in seconds, the bucket is full again.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The bucket as the IETF httpapi draft's structured field: `"<policy>";q=<requests>;w=<window seconds>`.

RateLimit.description: What is left of it as the draft's structured field: `"<policy>";r=<requests left>;t=<seconds until full>`.

Meteroid-Version.name: Meteroid-Version
Meteroid-Version.description: The API version to serve, as a date: the latest version published on or before it. The first, 2026-12-01, when left out; a date before it, or not a date, is refused (`400 unsupported_version`). Published: 2026-12-01, 2026-12-15.

Idempotency-Key.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency-Key.description: Taken by an operation whose `x-idempotency` is `required` or `optional` (a POST, and a PATCH whose body lists changes), kept 24 hours; a `required` one is refused without it (`400 idempotency_key_required`). Any other PATCH, a PUT and a DELETE are sent again as they are. A retry with the same key and request replays the first response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`), or an `IdempotentReplayMarker` (its `x-replay-marker`) when the first response was not kept; the same key with another request is refused (`422 idempotency_key_reused`), and while the first still runs (`409 idempotency_request_in_progress`).

X-Request-Id.name: X-Request-Id
X-Request-Id.description: Your id of the request, up to 128 visible ASCII characters: answered as `Request-Id` and in a problem's `request_id`. One is generated when left out.

Meteroid-Version.description: The version the request was served at.

Request-Id.description: The id of the request: the `X-Request-Id` sent, else a generated one. Quote it to support.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` on the replay of the first response to a request with the same `Idempotency-Key`: its status and body, or an `IdempotentReplayMarker` when the first response was not kept (read the resource by its `id`).

tags.description: What an invoice gives back: to the customer's balance, in money, or as debt cancelled.

tags.name: Credit units
tags.description: Denominations usage is priced and credit granted in instead of money, each with its selling price per currency.

tags.name: Custom properties
tags.description: The properties a tenant defines on its customers, subscriptions, invoices, credit notes and quotes, which their `custom_properties` are checked against.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Who is billed: named by id or by alias (`ext:<alias>`), with their addresses, tax and invoicing settings and portal token, and what is theirs under the customer's path: what they may use (the snapshot, the check, usage counted by your app, overrides), their resources, credit per currency or credit unit (wallets, grants, the ledger, top-ups), usage, and budgets in the Enterprise edition.

tags.name: Entitlements
tags.description: Any row giving a feature a value, whoever it belongs to, and its history: an edit keeps the row's id and adds a version.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Usage events, ingested for metering and billing: 1 to 500 a request, each naming its `customer` by id or `ext:<alias>`, its properties strings, numbers or booleans.

tags.name: Features
tags.description: What a customer may use (a flag, a limit, a value), its policy and the level it applies per, granted by its defaults, plan versions, add-ons, products, subscriptions and customer overrides.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: What a customer is billed: drafts priced as usage comes in, then issued, paid, voided or written off.

tags.name: Managed quantities
tags.description: Counts a subscription holds and changes (seats), shared by the charges naming them.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: What usage is measured by: the usage events of an event code, aggregated. Several metrics may read one event code, each its own way.

tags.name: Plans
tags.description: A plan is a price sheet: versions of charges in options, written through a draft and published.

tags.name: Pricing pages
tags.description: A product family's pricing page, priced in one currency and option.

tags.name: Product families
tags.description: The product lines a catalog is sorted in, each with its pricing page.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: What is sold. How it is billed is each charge's.

tags.name: Rate cards
tags.description: Dated rates of a metric's usage by its dimensions, and their history.

tags.name: Resources
tags.description: What a customer has several of (sites, workspaces): types with identifying keys and attributes, one level below the customer. A customer's stored resources are under `/customers/{id_or_alias}/resources`.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: A customer on a plan: its seats, levels, charges and add-ons, changed now or at the period's end, each change previewed first; its entitlements and usage.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: The tenant's usage by metric. A customer's and a subscription's are under their own paths.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Endpoints Meteroid POSTs signed event payloads to, their signing secret, and their deliveries.

**Verifying a delivery.** Every delivery is signed as the Standard Webhooks specification describes (https://www.standardwebhooks.com), so its libraries verify it (https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks/tree/main/libraries): pass them the endpoint's secret as it reads, the headers and the raw body. Each delivery carries three headers. `webhook-id` is the event's id (`evt_…`, its payload's `id`), the same on every attempt and resend of it: deduplicate by it. `webhook-timestamp` is the Unix time, in seconds, the attempt was sent. `webhook-signature` is `v1,` followed by the base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the HMAC-SHA256 of `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<body>`, the body's bytes exactly as received: verify them before parsing. The HMAC key is the secret's bytes, the base64 after its `whsec_` prefix decoded, not the string itself. While a rotated-out secret still signs (24 hours after its rotation), the header holds one signature per secret, separated by spaces, the current one first: accept the delivery when any of them matches, compared in constant time. Refuse a timestamp more than 5 minutes away from your clock, so a delivery captured on the way cannot be replayed later. An endpoint migrated from Svix also receives the same three values as `svix-id`, `svix-timestamp` and `svix-signature`.

Payload versions. An endpoint's `api_version` pins the shape of what it receives. From `2026-12-15` on, each event is the envelope `{id, type, created_at, api_version, data}` documented here: `data` is the resource as its v2 GET reads it (the same schema, references, typed ids and decimals), read when the event is processed, or for a notification what it observed beside the resources it is about, read alike (a wallet's notice its wallet, credit moving its ledger entry and grant too). An endpoint created through v2 holds the `Meteroid-Version` its request named, or the latest version when it named none; one created from the dashboard the latest version too; one holding `2026-12-01`, or none (created through v1, or before versions were recorded), receives API v1's payloads, which v1's document describes. `PATCH /api/v2/webhooks/endpoints/{id}` with `api_version` moves an endpoint to another version from its next event on; nothing else does: a pinned endpoint never changes shape, and a payload is the same bytes on every retry and resend. A resource deleted before its event is processed is named by its `id` alone (a wallet, which has none, by its currency or credit unit).
